title: Founding Engineer (Remote or Hybrid - EEA/UK)
description:
Founding Engineer


Role can be based remotely in the EEA or hybrid in our London or Munich offices.

Fixed software is the wrong shape for logistics, because every team runs its processes differently. Tare is our solution. Combining agentic AI with deterministic logic means Tare fits to any customer but runs the same way every single time. We have just closed our pre-seed funding round with a top European VC and we are now looking for a founding engineer to build Tare with us.

About Tarebase

We're Dom and Felix, the two co-founders of Tarebase. Dom is a former SVP at a global unicorn, overseeing tens of millions in global carrier spend, with deep logistics domain experience from Amazon, Nestle and EY. Felix was a founding engineer at Raycast and has spent more than two decades building software systems. We've raised pre-seed funding from a top-tier European VC and are building our MVP together with early design partners, who will become our first customers. As our first employee, you'd have a real say in both the product and the engineering decisions behind it.

Logistics is difficult to run well, and experienced people are hard to hire. Smaller businesses often pay too much for shipping, struggle to give customers a good delivery experience, and can't match larger competitors' technology or hiring budgets. The software available to them is often expensive, dated or too cumbersome. We want to make logistics less of a burden so these businesses can spend more time selling their products.They're the customers we want to build for: Europe alone has around 26 million SMEs, employing more than 100 million people.

Just putting a chat interface and GPT-wrapper on top of the problem is not what we're building. We're combining extraction and analysis, workflow automation, agentic and compiled AI with deterministic, verifiable logic. Recent advances in AI make more of this possible, but building a system that does it reliably is still hard. We're looking for someone who wants to advance the state of the art in this area with us.

About you

The description below is an ideal, not a checklist. If you don't tick every box but feel ready for the challenges of being the first engineer at an early-stage startup, we'd still like to hear from you. What matters most to us is that you're motivated, committed, willing to stick with hard problems, and someone we can count on.

You have a strong technical background and a track record of building and shipping software systems, whether that's cloud backends, web applications, AI-supported systems or a mix of these. You enjoy working across engineering and product. You think like a product engineer: you care about UX/UI, and you want direct contact with customers and the people who use what you build.

You'll work mostly in Rust and TypeScript, across the full stack: data engineering, AI, backend, frontend, infrastructure and deployment. We especially value experience with either language from before AI coding tools and a solid understanding of its ecosystem so you can make considered choices. We also value experience operating distributed systems and data-intensive systems in the cloud, including multi-tenant environments and the scaling and security challenges they bring, databases, and durable execution runtimes.

You use coding agents effectively, but stay close to the code. You know their limitations in a large codebase, review and challenge their work, and take testing, debugging, refactoring and documentation seriously. You can design useful tests and evaluations, manage complexity, and tell when something is genuinely ready to ship.

You also enjoy digging into challenging problems. You keep up with what current models, agent harnesses and research make possible, and you can judge what actually works for a given use case. You know how to build agents and AI workflows into a product and use evaluations, validation and deterministic logic to make what they produce consistent and verifiable. You're comfortable extracting structure from messy documents and care a lot about data quality. You experiment, measure the results, question your assumptions, and keep going until you've found a solution that really holds up.

You can turn that work into shipped software, taking a product idea or technical direction through design and implementation without waiting for someone to assign you a ticket. We work remotely, so clear communication and follow-through matter a lot to us. We value people who manage their own work, can be counted on, and raise important issues early.

How to apply

Apply with the button on this page.

Please ensure to use a hand-written CV. We read every application ourselves. It's fine to use tools for spelling or translation, but we want to hear your voice.

Our process

The process should take a few weeks from start to finish depending on your availability.

  1. Application review. If we love your resume we will send over some short questions.

  2. Intro call with Dom and Felix. An informal conversation about the role, the technology and what you're looking for.

  3. Technical deep dive with Felix. We talk briefly about a system you’ve worked on (no need to share anything confidential), then work through a system design problem together.

  4. Half a day with us in Munich or London. We cover your travel, hotel if needed, and meals. You spend about two hours on a made-up task similar to the problems we work on, using your usual tools and coding agents. Then we have lunch, go through your work together, and talk through a customer scenario.

  5. References and offer. We speak with 1-2 people you've worked with (only with your agreement) and aim to decide within 48 hours.

If we don't move forward after the technical conversation or later, we'll share some feedback with you.

Compensation: €100.000–120.000 base salary plus 0.75–1% equity

Setup: A MacBook Pro and whatever else you need to work well. If you'd rather not work from home, we'll pay for a coworking space near you.

Location: Munich or London, or remote within Europe (GMT-1 to GMT+3) with regular meet-ups.

Unser Fokus liegt insbesondere auf Unternehmen mit vielen Standorten – etwa im Einzelhandel, in der Logistik und anderen energieintensiven Branchen.

Wer sind wir?

Python · FastAPI · React · TypeScript · PostgreSQL / Timeseries · Google Cloud · Docker · LLMs / AI Agents

Du musst nicht jedes einzelne Tool davon bereits beherrschen.

Wo arbeiten wir?

Gridty hat seinen Sitz in Köln. Wir arbeiten hybrid und treffen uns regelmäßig persönlich als Team.

Daher wäre es ideal, wenn du aus Köln oder der weiteren Region kommst bzw. regelmäßig vor Ort sein kannst. Gleichzeitig ist uns wichtiger, die richtige Person zu finden, als jeden Tag gemeinsam im selben Büro zu sitzen. 💻

  1. Kurzes Kennenlernen per Google Meet – ca. 15–30 Minuten
  2. Technisches und persönliches Gespräch – ca. 60 Minuten
  3. Persönliches Kennenlernen in Köln

Interesse?

Wir freuen uns darauf, dich kennenzulernen.

Aufgaben

Deine Aufgaben

Du übernimmst eine zentrale technische Rolle bei Gridty und entwickelst gemeinsam mit uns unsere Plattform weiter.

Konkret bedeutet das unter anderem:

  • Technische Ownership für zentrale Teile unserer Plattform und Software-Architektur
  • Weiterentwicklung unserer Backend-Services und APIs mit Python/FastAPI
  • Weiterentwicklung unseres React-/TypeScript-Frontends
  • Aufbau und Skalierung unserer Datenarchitektur für große Mengen an Energie- und Zeitreihendaten
  • Weiterentwicklung unserer KI-basierten Analysefunktionen und Integration von LLM-/Agenten-Workflows
  • Integration neuer Datenquellen, Messsysteme und externer APIs
  • Umsetzung technischer Kundenintegrationen und Unterstützung bei komplexem Troubleshooting
  • Sicherstellung von Code-Qualität durch Testing, Reviews und sinnvolle Engineering-Standards
  • Weiterentwicklung unserer Cloud-Infrastruktur, Deployments und CI/CD-Prozesse

Und vor allem: Du bekommst viel Gestaltungsspielraum und Verantwortung.

Wir sind ein kleines Team – gute Ideen verschwinden bei uns nicht in fünf Abstimmungsebenen, sondern können direkt Teil des Produkts werden.

Qualifikation

Wer bist du?

Du…

  • hast Lust, an einem Produkt mit echtem Impact auf Energieverbrauch und CO₂-Emissionen zu arbeiten.
  • magst Verantwortung, Gestaltungsspielraum und die Geschwindigkeit eines Startups.

  • fühlst dich im Backend und bei Software-Architektur zu Hause und hast gleichzeitig keine Angst davor, auch mal ins Frontend zu schauen.
  • hast Erfahrung mit Python und idealerweise FastAPI oder vergleichbaren Frameworks.
  • kennst dich mit JavaScript/TypeScript und modernen Frontend-Technologien wie React aus.
  • hast Erfahrung mit relationalen Datenbanken und idealerweise auch mit größeren Zeitreihendaten.
  • denkst nicht nur in Features, sondern auch in skalierbarer Architektur, sauberem Code, Testing, Security und zuverlässigem Betrieb.
  • kannst technische Entscheidungen eigenständig treffen und verständlich kommunizieren.
  • sprichst fließend Deutsch und Englisch.

Nice to have: Erfahrung mit Cloud-Infrastruktur, Data Engineering, LLMs/AI Agents, Energiesystemen oder IoT-/Messdaten. Entscheidend ist aber vor allem, dass du Lust hast, dich in diese Themen einzuarbeiten.

title: Android-Entwickler – Smarte Sportgeräte & Apps (m/w/d)
description:
Entwickle Android-Software, die Menschen in Bewegung bringt

Du möchtest Android-Apps entwickeln und sehen, wie dein Code in einem echten Produkt zum Einsatz kommt? Bei AUGLETICS entwickelst du Software für smarte Rudergeräte und unsere App. Du kannst neue Funktionen direkt ausprobieren und gemeinsam mit dem Team verbessern – vom ersten Prototyp bis zur zuverlässigen Anwendung.

Wir entwickeln und produzieren in Königs Wusterhausen bei Berlin. Unser Unternehmen hat rund 25 Mitarbeitende; im Softwareteam arbeitest du mit vier bis fünf Personen und direkt mit unserem CTO Christopher Klabunde. Wir haben viele Ideen und suchen jemanden, der mitdenkt, gerne programmiert und Wert auf gute Ergebnisse legt.

Das entwickelst du bei uns

  • Android-Funktionen für Gerät und App: Du entwickelst neue Features, verbesserst bestehende Abläufe und arbeitest an einer verständlichen, zuverlässigen Bedienung.

  • Das Zusammenspiel im Blick: Du arbeitest an Schnittstellen zwischen App, Gerätesoftware und Backend und hilfst, Datenflüsse und Fehlerfälle sauber zu lösen.

  • Ideen praktisch erproben: Du setzt Prototypen um, probierst sie am Rudergerät aus und entwickelst gute Ansätze mit dem Team weiter.

  • Qualität von Anfang an: Du schreibst nachvollziehbaren Code, beteiligst dich an Reviews und Tests und behebst Fehler nachhaltig.

  • KI sinnvoll einsetzen: Du nutzt KI-gestützte Entwicklungswerkzeuge für Ideen, Code, Tests und Fehleranalyse. Du verstehst und prüfst die Ergebnisse, bevor sie ins Produkt gelangen.

Das bringst du mit

  • Programmiergrundlagen und Lust auf native Android-Entwicklung mit Kotlin oder Java. Praktische Android-Erfahrung ist willkommen; wenn du dich neu in Android einarbeitest, interessieren uns dein bisheriger Lernweg und deine Motivation.

  • Du kannst erklären, wie du technische Aufgaben angehst. Eigene Apps, Lernprojekte, Hochschulprojekte, Praktika und Werkstudententätigkeiten zählen genauso wie berufliche Erfahrung.

  • Ein gutes Verständnis von Programmiergrundlagen und Interesse daran, verständliche, wartbare und getestete Software zu entwickeln.

  • Offenheit für KI-unterstützte App-Entwicklung. Wenn du solche Werkzeuge bereits ausprobiert hast, interessiert uns, was gut funktioniert hat und wie du die Ergebnisse geprüft hast.

  • Eigeninitiative, Freude an Zusammenarbeit und Lust, dich in ein bestehendes Produkt einzuarbeiten und schrittweise Verantwortung zu übernehmen.

  • Gutes Englisch in Wort und Schrift ist für den technischen Austausch im Team erforderlich. Deutschkenntnisse sind ein großer Vorteil, aber keine Voraussetzung.

  • Bereitschaft, regelmäßig in Königs Wusterhausen vor Ort zu arbeiten, um Funktionen am Gerät zu entwickeln und mit dem Team abzustimmen.

Ein Studium der Informatik oder einer vergleichbaren Fachrichtung, eine passende Ausbildung oder vergleichbare Kenntnisse sind eine gute Grundlage.

Mit Erfahrung oder am Anfang: Wir wollen dich kennenlernen

Du hast schon mehrere Jahre Erfahrung in diesem Bereich? Super – bring deine Ideen und deinen Blick von außen ein. Du stehst noch am Anfang oder hast bisher keine Berufserfahrung in diesem Bereich? Auch das ist in Ordnung. Wenn du für unser Produkt brennst, technische Grundlagen mitbringst und dich schnell in neue Themen einarbeitest, möchten wir dich kennenlernen.

In beiden Fällen ist es unsere Aufgabe, dich gut ins Team zu integrieren und dir Wissen, Werkzeuge und Unterstützung für einen erfolgreichen Start bereitzustellen. Gemeinsam mit Chris und dem Team lernst du unser Produkt und unsere Abläufe kennen. Aufgaben und Verantwortung stimmen wir auf deinen Erfahrungsstand ab und entwickeln sie mit dir weiter.

Zusätzliche Pluspunkte

  • Erfahrung mit Firebase als Backend für Apps, zum Beispiel bei Benutzeranmeldung, Datenspeicherung oder serverseitiger Logik.

  • Erfahrung in der iOS-Entwicklung, idealerweise mit Swift oder SwiftUI.

  • Kenntnisse in Git, automatisierten Tests, CI/CD oder der Anbindung von APIs und Geräten.

Darauf kannst du dich freuen

  • Ein eigenes Produkt, das du direkt ausprobieren kannst, und sichtbaren Einfluss auf das Training unserer Kunden.

  • Ein kleines Softwareteam, direkte Zusammenarbeit mit CTO Christopher Klabunde und kurze Wege zwischen Idee, Entwicklung und Test.

  • Raum für eigene Ideen und fachliche Entwicklung – mit Aufgaben, die zu deinem Erfahrungsstand passen und mit dir wachsen.

  • Unbefristete Vollzeitstelle mit 40 Stunden pro Woche und 28 Urlaubstagen im Jahr.

  • 50.000 bis 65.000 € brutto pro Jahr, abhängig von deinen relevanten Fähigkeiten und Erfahrungen.

  • Arbeitsplatz Zur Heide 10 in Königs Wusterhausen bei Berlin. Ein bis zwei Tage Homeoffice pro Woche sind nach Absprache möglich.

Dein Arbeitsplatz bei Berlin

Unser Standort ist Zur Heide 10 in Königs Wusterhausen. Der Bahnhof Königs Wusterhausen ist mit der S-Bahn S46 und Regionalzügen direkt an Berlin angebunden. Die Strecke vom Bahnhof zu uns lässt sich mit dem Fahrrad zurücklegen. Vor Ort entwickelst und testest du direkt am Produkt; ein bis zwei Tage Homeoffice pro Woche sind nach Absprache möglich.

Einfach bewerben

Schick uns deinen Lebenslauf auf Deutsch oder Englisch. Ein klassisches Anschreiben brauchst du nicht. Ein GitHub-Link oder eine App ist willkommen, aber keine Voraussetzung.

Wenn du magst: vier kurze Fragen

Die Antworten sind freiwillig. Stichpunkte reichen – auf Deutsch oder Englisch. Kein zusätzliches Dokument und keine Probeaufgabe nötig.

  1. Was reizt dich daran, Software für ein smartes Sportgerät zu entwickeln? Was würdest du gern bei uns lernen oder voranbringen?

  2. Was hast du bisher programmiert oder dir selbst beigebracht? Wenn du schon mit Android, Firebase oder iOS gearbeitet hast: Was war dein eigener Beitrag? Ein Link ist willkommen.

  3. Welche KI-Werkzeuge hast du beim Entwickeln oder Lernen ausprobiert, und wie prüfst du die Ergebnisse? Wenn du noch keine genutzt hast: Was würdest du gern ausprobieren?

  4. Wie sicher fühlst du dich beim technischen Austausch auf Englisch? Passt regelmäßige Arbeit vor Ort in Königs Wusterhausen für dich, und ab wann könntest du starten?

Zum Einstieg lernen wir uns in einem kurzen Onlinegespräch kennen. Danach schauen wir gemeinsam auf deine bisherigen Erfahrungen, deinen Lernweg und die Aufgaben bei AUGLETICS.

English-speaking applicants are welcome. English is required; German is a strong plus. You will develop Android software for our connected rowing machines and app, working closely with our CTO and a small team. Early-career developers with practical projects are welcome. Based in Königs Wusterhausen near Berlin, with one to two home-office days per week by agreement.

title: Teamlead Customer Support & Sales (m/w/d)
description:
Du machst aus unserem Support ein Team, das Kund:innen hält und gewinnt

Bei eRecht24 melden sich jeden Tag Website-Betreiber, Online-Shops und Agenturen: per Ticket, per Telefon, mit Fragen zu Tarifen, Rechnungen und Rechtstexten. Hinter vielen dieser Anfragen steckt mehr als ein Supportfall: ein Upgrade, das hilft, eine Kündigung, die sich abwenden lässt, eine Agentur, die zwanzig Kundenprojekte im kleinsten Tarif verwaltet.

Wir suchen eine erfahrene Person, die unser Customer-Support-Team führt, den Betrieb stabil und messbar macht und daraus Schritt für Schritt eine Kundenberatung mit Vertriebsblick aufbaut. Du führst, du planst, und du bist selbst am Telefon.

Wer wir sind und wo wir stehen

eRecht24 ist Deutschlands größte Plattform für Rechtssicherheit im Web: Impressum Generator, Datenschutz Generator, Website Scanner und viele weitere Tools, kostenlos im Freemium-Bereich und vollumfänglich in eRecht24 PREMIUM (Basic, Business, Enterprise).

Die Firma ist in wenigen Jahren stark gewachsen und professionalisiert sich gerade: neue Rollen in Marketing, Product und Data, ein Data Warehouse, klarere Prozesse. Im Support sind die Werkzeuge da, ein modernes Ticketsystem und eine voll funktionsfähige Telefonanlage. Der Support betreut inzwischen die gesamte Unternehmensgruppe. Was fehlt, ist eine Führung, die daraus ein belastbares System macht.

Deine Aufgaben

Team führen und Betrieb steuern

  • Du führst das Customer-Support-Team fachlich und disziplinarisch, arbeitest Mitarbeitende ein und entwickelst sie weiter.

  • Du planst Einsätze, Urlaube und Vertretungen und sorgst dafür, dass wir erreichbar sind und Anfragen zeitnah bearbeitet werden.

  • Du analysierst Kontaktvolumen, Bearbeitungszeiten und Kapazität, erkennst Engpässe früh und begründest, wann wir mehr Leute brauchen.

Qualität, Prozesse und Systeme

  • Du etablierst Service-, Qualitäts- und Dokumentationsstandards, Gesprächsleitfäden und Kennzahlen.

  • Du bewertest unsere Support- und Telefoniesysteme, empfiehlst Verbesserungen und steuerst freigegebene Systemwechsel samt Migration.

Kundenberatung und Sales aufbauen

  • Du baust die telefonische Beratung aus: Inbound und Outbound, Produkt- und Tarifberatung, Unterstützung bei Tarifwechseln, Upselling, das wirklich zum Bedarf passt.

  • Kund:innen zurückgewinnen: Du holst gekündigte und inaktive Kund:innen zurück, verstehst, warum sie gegangen sind, und entwickelst mit dem Marketing die passenden Angebote.

  • Du bindest Kund:innen und beugst Kündigungen vor, gerade bei Business- und Enterprise-Kund:innen und Agenturen.

  • Du spielst Kundenwissen zurück: Wer sind unsere besten Kund:innen, was brauchen sie, woran scheitern sie? Gemeinsam mit Marketing und Product schärfst du so unser Bild der idealen Kund:innen.

So verteilt sich deine Zeit: rund 40 % operativ im Kundenkontakt, davon ein guter Teil am Telefon, 30 % Führung und Kapazitätssteuerung, 30 % Prozesse, Telefonie und Systeme. In der Einarbeitung ist der operative Anteil höher.

Deine ersten Monate

  • Monat 1 bis 3: Produkt, Tarife und Kundenanliegen kennenlernen, das Team übernehmen, Erreichbarkeit stabilisieren, Kapazitäten und Engpässe analysieren.

  • Monat 3 bis 6: Qualitätsstandards und Kennzahlen etablieren, Telefonberatung strukturiert aufbauen, Systeme bewerten, Personal- und Prozessbedarf ableiten.

  • Danach: Beratung und Sales weiterentwickeln, Reporting aufbauen, Prozesse standardisieren und skalierbar machen.

Was du mitbringen solltest

  • Mehrjährige Erfahrung im Customer Support, Customer Success, Inside Sales oder Contact Center, idealerweise bei einem SaaS- oder Abo-Anbieter

  • Erfahrung als Führungskraft eines Support-, Service- oder Inside-Sales-Teams, inklusive Einsatz- und Kapazitätsplanung

  • Du hast Inbound- und Outbound-Telefonie selbst gemacht und aufgebaut und telefonierst gern: erst zuhören, dann beraten

  • Du erkennst Kaufsignale und Einwände und gehst mit beiden souverän um, ohne Rabatt als ersten Reflex

  • Sicher mit Ticket- und Telefoniesystemen; idealerweise hast du schon einmal ein System ausgewählt, eingeführt oder migriert

  • Du arbeitest mit Kennzahlen und kannst Personalbedarf nachvollziehbar begründen

  • Strukturiert, verlässlich, entscheidungsfreudig im Tagesgeschäft

  • Deutsch auf C2-Niveau, in Wort und Schrift. Du berätst unsere Kund:innen am Telefon auf Deutsch

  • Plus: Erfahrung im Aufbau eines Service- oder Beratungsbereichs, mit Retention und Rückgewinnung, mit Agenturen als Kund:innen, Nähe zu Website-Recht oder Datenschutz

Ein bestimmter Abschluss ist nicht nötig. Entscheidend sind Führungserfahrung, Aufbaukompetenz und die Lust, selbst mit anzupacken.

Warum sich die Rolle lohnt

  • Echter Gestaltungsspielraum: Du entscheidest selbst über Einsatzplanung, Prioritäten, Standards, Leitfäden und Einarbeitung.

  • Werkzeuge sind da: Ticketsystem, Telefonanlage, Data Warehouse. Du musst nicht bei null anfangen, sondern daraus ein System bauen.

  • Sichtbarer Impact: Jede gerettete Kündigung, jedes passende Upgrade ist messbar und wird gesehen.

  • Kurze Wege: Du berichtest direkt an die Marketing-Leitung und arbeitest eng mit Marketing, Product und IT.

Rahmenbedingungen

  • Vollzeit

  • Hybrid in Berlin, mindestens drei Präsenztage pro Woche vor Ort

  • Operative Mitarbeit während unserer Supportzeiten von 9 bis 16 Uhr

  • Fachliche und disziplinarische Führungsverantwortung

Klingt nach dir?

Dann lass uns sprechen: 15 Minuten Kennenlernen, ein einstündiges Fachgespräch, dann Team und ein kurzes Rollenspiel aus unserem Alltag.

Ein Anschreiben brauchen wir nicht. Beantworte uns stattdessen in der Bewerbung kurz drei Fragen:

  1. Welches Team hast du zuletzt geführt (Größe, Aufgabe), und was hast du dort als Erstes verändert?

  2. Welche Kundin oder welchen Kunden hast du zuletzt zurückgeholt oder von der Kündigung abgehalten, und wie?

  3. Wie viel Zeit verbringst du heute selbst am Telefon mit Kund:innen?

title: Senior CRM Manager (m/w/d) - E-Mail-Marketing & Automation
description:
Du baust nicht nur Kampagnen, sondern den Kanal, über den eRecht24 verkauft

Bei uns ist E-Mail kein Begleitkanal, sondern der Kanal, über den aus kostenlosen Nutzer:innen zahlende Kund:innen werden und aus Kund:innen bessere Kund:innen. Wir haben kein klassisches Sales-Team. Was das Marketing nicht konvertiert, konvertiert niemand.

Wir suchen eine erfahrene Person, die diesen Kanal fachlich verantwortet: Strategie, Segmentierung, Automationen, Trigger, Testing, Zahlen. Hands-on in Brevo, im Austausch mit unserem Data-Team, im Sparring mit Product.

Wer wir sind und wo wir stehen

eRecht24 ist Deutschlands größte Plattform für Rechtssicherheit im Web: Impressum Generator, Datenschutz Generator, Website Scanner und viele weitere Tools, kostenlos im Freemium-Bereich und vollumfänglich in eRecht24 PREMIUM (Basic, Business, Enterprise). Unsere Kund:innen sind Website-Betreiber, Online-Shops, Agenturen und Webdesigner.

Die Firma ist in wenigen Jahren stark gewachsen: viel Freiheit, viel Tempo, einiges noch unaufgeräumt. Brevo läuft, Kampagnen gehen raus, ein Data Warehouse liefert Segmente. Was fehlt, ist die Person, die daraus ein System macht: Lifecycle statt Gießkanne, Trigger statt Kalender, Tests statt Bauchgefühl.

Wie du bei uns arbeitest

Unser Marketing arbeitet in Squads innerhalb eines Marketing-Tribes. Du verantwortest den E-Mail- und CRM-Squad und arbeitest dort eng mit unserer E-Mail-Marketing-Managerin zusammen. Dein wichtigster Sparringspartner ist die Rolle Senior Marketing Manager Customer Journey: Sie orchestriert die Journey über alle Kanäle, du besitzt den E-Mail-Kanal in der Tiefe.

Die Grenze zu Product ist klar: Onboarding- und System-Mails gehören dem Produkt-Team. Du verantwortest die Marketing-Mails, also Konversion, Upsell, Cross-Sell, Retention und Winback, und stimmst Timing und Überschneidungen mit Product ab.

Deine Aufgaben

  • Kanalverantwortung: Du entwickelst die CRM- und E-Mail-Strategie für unsere drei Kohorten und setzt sie um: Subscriber zu Freemium, Freemium zu eRecht24 PREMIUM, PREMIUM zu höheren Tarifen und Zusatzprodukten.

  • Automationen und Trigger: Du baust verhaltensbasierte Sequenzen in Brevo für Konversion, Upsell, Retention, Re-Engagement und Re-Permission, gespeist aus Plattform- und Tracking-Daten. Ein Teil dieser Infrastruktur entsteht gerade, zum Beispiel dynamische Angebotsblöcke in Mails, und du gestaltest mit.

  • Segmentierung mit Daten: Du arbeitest direkt mit unserem BI-Team (Data Warehouse auf BigQuery) an Zielgruppen, Selektionen und Ausschlüssen. Du weißt, was du brauchst, und kannst es formulieren, gern auch in SQL.

  • Kampagnen und Copy: Du planst Kampagnen im Jab-Jab-Jab-Punch-Rhythmus (erst Mehrwert, dann Angebot) und in Batches, schreibst mit KI-Unterstützung auf Basis unserer Wording-Guidelines und finalisierst selbst. Fachinhalte kommen aus Legal und Content.

  • Kontaktregeln und Hygiene: Du definierst und setzt durch, wer wann was bekommt, zum Beispiel: Wer gerade in einer Sequenz steckt, bekommt keine Upsell-Mail. Dazu Listenqualität, Double-Opt-in, Einwilligungen, Bounce-Management und ein sauberer Umgang mit Inaktiven. Wir sind der Rechtssicherheits-Anbieter, unsere Mails sind es auch.

  • Testing und Zahlen: A/B-Tests (Betreff, CTA, Timing, Inhalt), Conversion je Kohorte, Umsatzbeitrag von E-Mail. Du verantwortest eine klare Zielzahl, den Umsatzbeitrag aus E-Mail, und berichtest monatlich, was funktioniert und was du deshalb änderst.

  • Schnittstellen: Customer Journey, Performance Marketing, Content, Product und Support.

Was wir nicht von dir erwarten

  • Ads schalten oder Social Media bespielen

  • Fachinhalte von Grund auf schreiben (die kommen aus Legal und Content)

  • Design (Vorlagen und Unterstützung sind da)

  • Personalführung

  • CRM-Administration oder -Customizing (Salesforce, Dynamics, SAP und Co.)

Was du mitbringen solltest

  • 5+ Jahre E-Mail-Marketing oder CRM im B2B-, SaaS- oder Subscription-Umfeld, davon mehrere Jahre mit eigener Kanalverantwortung

  • Nachweisbare Erfolge mit Lifecycle-Automationen und Segmentierung (Freemium-to-Paid, Upsell, Churn-Prevention), nicht nur Newsletter

  • Sicher in einem Automation-Tool (Brevo, HubSpot, ActiveCampaign, Klaviyo, Salesforce Marketing Cloud); Brevo-Praxis ist ein starkes Plus

  • Datenaffin: SQL-Grundkenntnisse oder die Bereitschaft, sie zu lernen

  • Conversion-Copywriting auf Deutsch: klar, kurz, ohne Marketing-Sprech. Deutsch auf C2-Niveau, Englisch gut

  • Routine mit KI im Workflow und das Urteil, wann das Ergebnis gut genug ist

  • Hands-on-Mindset in einem Umfeld, das sich gerade professionalisiert

  • Plus: Legal-Tech-, Compliance- or Rechtsthemen-Hintergrund, Erfahrung mit CDPs oder Cross-Domain-Tracking, Matomo

Warum sich die Rolle lohnt

  • Der wichtigste Umsatzkanal der Firma liegt bei dir.

  • Daten sind da: BI-Team, Data Warehouse, Plattform-Tracking.

  • Kein Leerlauf: Ein Backlog an Kampagnen-Konzepten wartet auf jemanden, der priorisiert und rausbringt.

  • Kurze Wege zur Marketing-Leitung, zu Product und zur Geschäftsführung.

  • AI-first, organisationsweit und von der Geschäftsführung getragen.

Rahmenbedingungen

  • Vollzeit

  • Hybrid in Berlin, drei Präsenztage pro Woche vor Ort

  • Keine Personalverantwortung, du berichtest an die Marketing-Leitung

Klingt nach dir?

15 Minuten Kennenlernen, ein einstündiges Fachgespräch, dann Team und eine kleine Aufgabe aus unserem Alltag.

Ein Anschreiben brauchen wir nicht. Beantworte uns stattdessen in der Bewerbung kurz drei Fragen:

  1. Welche Automation oder Sequenz hast du zuletzt selbst gebaut, und was hat sie in Zahlen gebracht?

  2. Mit welchem Tool arbeitest du heute, und wie groß ist die Liste, die du verantwortest?

  3. Wie entscheidest du, wer eine Mail nicht bekommt?

title: Program Manager, Aircraft
description:
Swarm Aero is redefining air power, building the largest swarming UAV and the most versatile swarming aircraft network in the world. The company is moving quickly to launch the first aircraft designed specifically for swarming, as well as the Command & Control software to mobilize swarms of thousands of heterogeneous autonomous assets and empower human operators to achieve superhuman results.

The team has created and exited multiple startups, negotiated defense deals worth billions of dollars, and designed and built 30+ novel aircraft, with aerospace experience from Scaled Composites, Airbus, Archer Aviation, Blue Origin, and Boom Supersonic.

Our aircraft work is scaling fast. Our Group 5 aircraft program runs alongside a growing set of research programs, with design, build, supply chain, and test all moving in parallel. We need one strong Program Manager to lead program management across all of it.

You will join our Program Management Office, reporting to the Director of PMO. You will take full ownership of our research programs and partner with the Director to run the aircraft program, owning cost, schedule, scope, risk, and the customer relationship. You will be the person who knows where every aircraft effort actually stands on any given day.

What you'll do

• Own our research programs end to end as the primary point of contact for government program managers and contracting teams

• Drive program execution on our aircraft program with the Director of PMO, from design reviews through fabrication, integration, ground test, and flight test

• Build and maintain the integrated master schedule (IMS) across both efforts, tied to contract milestones and test events

• Own budgets and burn, track against funding, and flag variance early with a recovery plan

• Manage scope changes, contract modifications, and follow-on work with our contracts and business development teams

• Build the PMO tools and processes we will need as we add aircraft programs

What you bring

• 7+ years of program management, with at least 4 years owning cost, schedule, and technical performance on aircraft, UAS, or other aerospace and defense hardware programs

• Direct experience managing DoD research and development contracts (S&T, prototype, or 6.2/6.3 efforts)

• Track record taking aircraft or aerospace hardware through build and test, ideally to first flight

• Working knowledge of government contract execution: CDRLs, funded vs. ceiling value, modifications, and customer reporting

• Hands-on with IMS development (MS Project, Primavera, Smartsheet or similar), budget tracking, and EVM concepts

• Clear, direct communicator who can brief an engineer, an executive, and a government program manager

• U.S. person status as defined by ITAR, and ability to obtain and maintain a U.S. security clearance

Nice to have

• Program experience on Group 3 to Group 5 UAS, collaborative autonomy, or experimental aircraft

• Experience with OTA, SBIR/STTR, or other rapid acquisition contract vehicles

• Familiarity with airworthiness and flight test planning

• Background at a startup or fast-scaling hardware company

• Active Secret clearance or higher

• PMP or DAWIA Program Management certification

  • Support Engineering serves as the escalation point between Support Specialists and Product Engineering. Owns integrations, supports data mapping and data migrations for customers, and resolves escalated tickets that don't require product code changes.

Please choose the role that best reflects your experience and interests rather than applying to both. If another Support role seems like a closer match, we’ll consider that in our review.

About the role

Support Engineering is the technical layer between frontline Support and Engineering. You’ll take on complex issues involving integrations, APIs, permissions, data, reporting, migrations, and workflows—using application behavior, logs, databases, and customer context to determine whether an issue can be resolved through Support or represents a product defect.

You’ll investigate issues end to end using tools such as Plain, GitHub, Datadog, databases, and the codebase. You won’t write the fix; you’ll give Engineering a well-validated escalation with reproduction steps, relevant evidence, customer impact, and a root-cause hypothesis when possible. You’ll also identify recurring issues, improve documentation and enablement, and partner with Product and Engineering on improvements. As an early Support Engineer in EMEA, you’ll establish regional operating practices and handoff norms across European time zones while bringing EMEA customer patterns to a global team.

What you’ll own

The company

Small businesses move fast. Opportunities often don’t wait, and cash flow pressures can appear overnight. To keep going, and growing, SMEs need finance that’s as flexible and responsive as they are.

That's why we built iwoca. Our smart technology, data science and five-star customer service ensures business owners can act with the speed, confidence and control they need, exactly when it's needed.

Our ultimate mission is to support one million SMEs in their defining moments, creating lasting impact for the communities and economies they drive.

The team

Introducer Tech builds the systems that partners in Germany use to refer businesses to iwoca. The aim is to get new partners integrated quickly and to make applying simple for their customers. The team also looks after how partners earn commission.

Its work covers three main areas:

  • The Lending API. Developing the versioned API and the webhooks that keep partners up to date on their customers.

  • The Introducer Portal. Building the web app that German brokers log in to, to submit applications and upload documents.

  • The sign-up journey. Improving how businesses apply and how well they convert, after a partner referral.

The team is growing to have two product managers, who each focus on either the broker or the partner flow, and three engineers across the backend and frontend, including this hire.

The team currently works in sprints, with three stand-ups a week and planning every two weeks. However, there is room to adapt how it works as it grows.

The role

You'll be the senior engineer behind iwoca's broker and partner channels in Germany, from the tools partners integrate with to the internal systems that broker account managers use.

Ownership and autonomy

  • Own the Lending API in Germany end to end, deciding what to build, when to release a new version, when to retire an old one, and what iwoca can promise partners.

  • Own the developer portal and every tool partners use to integrate, from documentation that their developers and coding agents can build from to self-serve testing that needs no help from iwoca.

Impact

  • Ship the features that make partners choose iwoca, starting with pre-qualification, which shows a customer what they could borrow before they apply.

  • Make integration quick and simple, so a partner can go live with few questions and little hand-holding.

  • Automate parts of the broker funnel and the internal CRM that broker account managers use, cutting friction and the lag between a decision and the action that follows, and building agents wherever they help.

Growth trajectory

  • Set the team's technical direction and shape the product and technical roadmap alongside the product manager.

We expect to pay from £80,000 to £100,000 for this role. But, we’re open-minded, so definitely include your salary goals with your application. We routinely benchmark salaries against market rates, and run quarterly performance and salary reviews.

At iwoca, the best idea wins. We model our culture on independent thinking, challenging untested logic, and evidence-based decisions. We prioritise learning and growth, and give people the autonomy to develop in the direction that makes them most effective.

What you’ll do

  • Lead, coach, and grow the sales team for the Mid-Market and SMB segment, including hiring, performance, and day-to-day execution.

  • Define and refine the sales approach for SMB and Mid-Market customers, adapting qualification, messaging, and deal support to each customer’s needs.

  • Build an efficient path from target account and first conversation through qualification, evaluation, close, handoff, and expansion.

  • Coach sellers on discovery, value-based selling, pipeline discipline, and helping customers make decisions with confidence.

  • Make clear, evidence-based recommendations to Product based on customer conversations, deal patterns, and segment needs.

  • Work with BDR and Growth leaders to build qualified pipeline through targeted outbound and other relevant channels.

  • Partner with Field Marketing to prioritize campaigns, events, customer advocacy, and community programs that support pipeline and revenue goals. Work within the marketing leadership’s standards and methods, and ensure programs are well executed and measured.

  • Set direction for how Partnerships can support segment priorities, working with the Partnerships lead on relevant sourcing, co-selling, and delivery opportunities.

  • Coordinate with Solutions Engineering, Deployment, Professional Services, and Customer Success to support effective evaluations, smooth implementations, adoption, and expansion.

  • Share market learning with the CRO and other segment leads, helping Dust develop a coherent France go-to-market approach.

What we’re looking for

  • A proven B2B software sales professional who has grown from individual contributor into people leadership, with 5+ years leading sales teams and a hands-on understanding of how to help sellers succeed.

  • Experience selling to SMB and Mid-Market customers, with the judgment to adapt the sales motion to different deal sizes, buying processes, and customer needs.

  • A track record of owning a segment or market revenue number end to end and building pipeline through functions you did not directly manage.

  • Experience coaching sellers, building a reliable forecast, and creating consistent sales practices.

  • Good commercial judgment about where to focus team capacity and budget, including how direct sales, marketing, and partners can support growth.

  • Strong collaboration skills across BDR, Growth, Field Marketing, Partnerships, RevOps, and post-sales teams.

  • High EQ, clear communication, and a supportive but accountable leadership style.

  • Comfort building repeatable sales practices in a scaling organization. French fluency and strong working English are important.

What success looks like

The Mid-Market and SMB segment has clear sales ownership, a focused pipeline, and progress against its ARR goals. Sellers are well coached and can execute an efficient, repeatable motion suited to their customers. Cross-functional support is aligned to segment priorities, and learning from customers and deals helps Dust improve how it serves and grows SMB and Mid-Market accounts in France.

Location

We're prioritizing building our team with an in-person culture at our offices in Paris, London, San Francisco, and New York because we value the magic that happens when talented people work closely together.

We have an office-first culture. Some of the best things about building at Dust are the energy, the fast decisions, and the unexpected conversations that unlock a hard problem, which happen because we are in the same room. Being together is not a formality, it is how we do our best work, and it is something we actively protect.

That said, we hire people with strong judgement and we extend that trust to how they manage their time. When working from home makes more sense for what you need to get done that day, we trust you to make that call.

Why Dust

The models are powerful enough. What's missing is the product layer where AI meets how companies actually work. That's what we're building: the infrastructure that lets any team turn scattered knowledge and tools into coordinated execution with agents they build, own, and run themselves.

We use Dust ourselves every day. We get to shape how humans and agents collaborate while solving our own problems with the product we ship. That loop is rare, and it's why we move fast.

If you're excited about defining a new category and want to join a determined team of optimists who focus on users, ship fast, and don't take themselves too seriously, we'd love to talk.

Even if you don't check every box in our requirements, we encourage you to apply. We value diverse perspectives and backgrounds, and we're more interested in your potential and passion than a perfect match to our checklist.

title: FTTH Security Expert
description:
About P1 Security

Founded in 2011 by serial entrepreneur and security expert Philippe Langlois, P1 Security is on a mission to secure critical and sovereign mobile networks by providing services and technologies to identify, detect and recover from critical threats and vulnerabilities.

P1 Security is one of the very few companies in the world tackling telecom security through pure Mobile and Telecom Security attacks and security from 5G and Cloud-based infrastructure Security, OpenRAN, Network Slicing and RAN Sharing, Edge Computing (MEC), down to legacy 2/3/4G Diameter, SS7 SIGTRAN attacks, GTP manipulation and fuzzing.

Our offering and expertise range from Network and Telecom Core Network Security, Intrusion Detection and Vulnerability Assessment solutions, with technology backed by more than a decade of engineering research. We are a lean scale-up, engaged in emerging markets (Eastern Europe, Middle East, Asia), Europe and North America.

The P1 Security team includes experts from telecom operators and security companies as well as renowned security researchers who regularly present unique P1 Security research at leading international security conferences & GSMA working groups. P1 Labs, the R&D branch of P1 Security, shares Open Source initiatives with the telecom security community (www.github.com/P1sec/).

We are growing the team with people who want to help write it. We are looking for experienced profiles with grounded, hands-on knowledge of telecom networks — and a real appetite for FTTx technologies in particular. Curious, creative and open-minded people who want to dig deep into a genuinely sovereign topic: the security of the mobile networks our connectivity runs on.

Job Description

If your years have been spent in FTTx — access networks, PON, CPE, provisioning, field operations — and security has always been the question you kept coming back to, talk to us. The role described below does not really exist as a box to tick yet: we care far more about the person than about an exact match with a job title. Bring the part of the picture you know best, and we will build the rest together.

What you will do

  • Audits — you will plan and run scoped, authorized penetration tests of FTTH/PON infrastructure: OLTs, ONTs/ONUs, the management systems around the ODN, and customer premises equipment.

  • PON internals — you will dig into GPON, XG-PON, XGS-PON and NG-PON2: OMCI, PLOAM, and how ONTs are authenticated and provisioned.

  • CPE and gateways — you will take them apart: firmware extraction and reverse engineering, exposed debug interfaces (UART/JTAG), hardcoded credentials, update mechanisms and web/CLI management flaws.

  • Subscribers at scale — you will look at what provisions and manages them (TR-069/CWMP, TR-369/USP, ACS/OSS/BSS integrations, zero-touch provisioning) and at the subscriber-facing edge: BNG/BRAS, PPPoE/IPoE, DHCP, RADIUS/AAA, VLAN segmentation, QoS and isolation between subscribers.

  • Convergence and infrastructure — you will follow fixed–mobile convergence (5G FWA, shared core, shared OSS/BSS, unified identity and billing) and review devices and management planes (routers, switches, aggregation equipment, NMS/EMS, SNMP, NETCONF/YANG, SSH/Telnet, APIs, privileged access) against vendor and industry hardening baselines.

  • Threat modeling — you will map attack paths for real operator environments using frameworks such as MITRE ATT&CK, the GSMA FASG/FS.xx guidance and the MITRE FiGHT knowledge base.

  • Findings and clients — you will turn all of this into clear, prioritized reports with proof-of-concept evidence, risk ratings and actionable remediation, present them to stakeholders, and support remediation verification and retesting.

  • The team — you will contribute to our internal tooling, test methodologies, lab environments and reusable attack playbooks.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Deep knowledge on Fixed-line network architecture (FTTx, DSL, Coaxial)

  • MANDATORY: Experience in security audit pentests on OT and IT infrastructure

  • Experience with vendor ecosystems such as Huawei, ZTE, Nokia, Ericsson, Calix, or Adtran FTTH equipment.

  • Familiarity with telecom security standards and frameworks: 3GPP SCAS, GSMA NESAS, ISO/IEC 27001, NIST CSF, and ITU-T/BBF specifications.

  • Experience in red teaming or adversary emulation against critical infrastructure.

  • Relevant certifications, such as:

  • OSCP / OSEP / OSWE / OSED

  • GPEN / GXPN / GRID

  • CEH (Practical), eJPT/eCPPT, or CRTO

  • Telecom-specific training (GSMA, Black Hat/DEF CON telecom or hardware trainings)

  • Published research, CVEs, conference talks, or bug bounty history in telecom or embedded devices.

If you have a passion for telecom security and want to be part of a dynamic and innovative team, we encourage you to apply and join us in shaping the future of Telecom Security!

Language requirements

  • English - fluent speaker

  • French - optional

Further details

  • 🏢 Headquarters: Fully remote company, with headquarters in Paris - FRANCE

  • 🏠 Remote policy:

  • At P1 Security, we recognize the importance of work-life balance, and that's why our remote policy is a key part of our company culture. We understand that flexibility is crucial, allowing our team members to work remotely while achieving their personal and professional goals. To keep our team connected, we schedule monthly meetups with department members and gather the entire team on-site every two months. These regular touch points ensure effective communication, collaboration, and a dynamic team spirit, reflecting the dynamic and adaptable spirit of P1 Security. We believe in the power of flexible work arrangements to bring out the best in our team, driving success in a way that suits everyone's unique lifestyle

Hiring process

  • First contact call (10-20min)

  • Direct manager call (30min)

  • Capability assessment exercice (depending on position)

Specialisations

Telecommunications Security, SS7, SIGTRAN, LTE, IMS, UMTS, CDMA, GPRS, OpenStack, Kubernetes, LinuxServers / PNF, Diameter, NFV, Security, VoLTE, VoWifi, GTP, Diameter, 3G, 4G, IoT Security, NFV(i), S1AP, X2AP, Fuzzing, eUTRAN S1AP, X2AP, NgRAN, NGAP, PFCP, 5GC SBI

Contact

If you are a motivated and experienced professional who is passionate about cybersecurity and driving innovation, we would love to hear from you! Join P1 Security and be part of a fascinating mission to protect critical infrastructure and work alongside industry experts in the cybersecurity field.

Vous interviendrez principalement sur l'intégration et la validation des équipements et sous-ensembles au sein des cryostats utilisés dans nos systèmes. Vous participerez également au suivi du fonctionnement et des maintenances des équipements cryogéniques, notamment les cryostats et leurs compresseurs associés. title: Research Engineer, Index Intelligence
description:
Exa is an applied AI lab building a search engine unlike the world has ever seen. We build massive-scale infra to crawl the entire web, train state-of-the-art embedding models to process it, and design super high performant vector databases to retrieve over it. We now power search for Cursor, Cognition, HubSpot, and over 400,000 developers and have raised $350m from Lightspeed, Benchmark, and a16z.

 

Our ultimate goal is to build perfect search over all the world's information, far beyond Google. If you want to build massive-scale ML systems that will define the way the new AI world consumes information, this is the place for you.

We crawl the web continuously and cannot keep all of it, refresh all of it, or spend a GPU on all of it. Something has to decide which pages are worth indexing, which links are worth following, which pages say the same thing as pages we already have, what has gone stale, and what we should never have picked up. These decisions are worth more than most ranking work. The cheapest way to improve search is to stop indexing pages nobody should ever retrieve, and to start indexing the ones we are missing. Today they run on a mix of learned signals and thresholds someone picked.

We are looking for a research engineer to own the signals behind those decisions, and the decisions themselves.

Desired Experience

  • You are comfortable owning a problem with no ground truth, where the first job is defining what the right answer means

  • Hands-on ML experience with classifiers, rankers and calibration, plus strong data instincts at web scale

  • You think in end-to-end impact. A signal only counts if a decision changes and search gets better

  • You like working across teams. Crawling, indexing and retrieval all consume what you build

  • You care about the problem of finding high quality knowledge and recognize how important this is for the world

Example Projects

  • Make parsing work on the pages where it currently does not, and prove the improvement rather than assert it

  • Teach a model to judge page quality, and get everyone to agree on what quality means well enough to supervise it

  • Work on credibility and misinformation as a modelling problem: what a page claims, whether it is a reliable source of it, and whether it was written for a reader or for a crawler

  • Decide whether two documents are semantically the same or genuinely different, so we can deduplicate the web without collapsing pages that a user would want to see separately

The work has two halves: construction pipelines that decide what to trust, and retrieval engines that decide how best to search it. Our goal is to give agents answers to any factual question about the world with unprecedented precision and completeness.

In this role, you'll own the query engine that searches hundreds of billions of claims across a variety of retrieval backends, from a distributed graph database to vector, full-text, time-series and geospatial indexes.

This is greenfield work with a massive scope. No off-the-shelf system answers precise questions over hundreds of billions of evidence-backed claims at agent speed, so you'll make foundational decisions, from storage layout and indexing across engines to the query language and the planner that routes work between them, that every query depends on.

What you'll do

  • Own storage and indexing across backends: data layout, partitioning and indexes for graph, vector, full-text, time-series and geospatial retrieval, with bulk snapshot builds and live ingest that never take the system down.

  • Decide how best to search: cost-based planning from cardinality estimates that chooses, for each question, which backends to use, in what order and how to join their results, executed as traversals, retrievals, filters and aggregations in one plan.

  • Make it fast at scale: serve thousands of queries per second, profiling and cutting p50/p99 latency, memory and cost per query under high concurrent load, from on-disk layout to network fan-out.

  • Keep answers consistent while the data converges: the graph is fed by live updates and bulk snapshots at once and is eventually consistent by design, so you'll own what a query may see while it converges: consistent snapshot promotion, ordered application of live updates and stable pagination across versions.

  • Measure precision and completeness: end-to-end checks every deployment must pass, plus evals and metrics that show when a plan returns wrong results or misses ones it should have found.

title: Senior AWS Platform Engineer
description:
At Luscii, we are creating space for care by building digital health applications that help people manage their health. Applications such as the Luscii Thuismeten app and OMRON Connect. Together with healthcare professionals around the world, we build technology that helps users receive the right care in the right place. Millions of people rely on our products every month, and behind every reliable healthcare experience is a cloud platform that simply works. As engineer working on our apps, you will play a vital role in modernising the cloud platform that powers the platform, creating a more reliable, scalable and future-proof foundation for millions of users worldwide.

OMRON Connect is one of the largest digital health platforms in our ecosystem, connecting millions of users with their healthcare data through OMRON devices. Much of the platform has grown over many years and was partly built by external partners. Today, we're investing heavily in bringing that knowledge, ownership and technical excellence in-house. This is not about replacing everything overnight. It is about making thoughtful engineering decisions, modernising step by step, and building a cloud platform that gives our engineering teams the foundations, tooling and confidence they need to deliver safely and independently.

Your work will have a direct impact on the reliability, scalability and cost-efficiency of a platform serving several million monthly active users across the world. You will help shape our cloud and engineering standards, introduce modern practices where they genuinely add value, and make Infrastructure as Code, observability and safe continuous delivery the default rather than the exception. By creating reusable infrastructure, improving developer experience and removing unnecessary complexity, you will help teams move faster without compromising reliability or security. Along the way, you will collaborate with engineers, influence technical direction and leave the platform in a significantly better state than you found it.

Your role

You will become one of the technical driving forces behind the cloud platforms that power our digital health applications. Working closely with fellow engineers, product teams and colleagues across countries, you will help shape and improve our cloud infrastructure, strengthen the developer experience and ensure reliability, security and scalability are built into the foundations of our technology. Your exact focus will evolve with the needs of our teams and the opportunities you identify to make a lasting impact.

This is a role for someone who enjoys solving difficult engineering problems without chasing complexity for complexity's sake. You will help us balance innovation with pragmatism, modernising a live healthcare platform while maintaining the stability that patients and healthcare professionals depend on every day.

What you will be doing, among others:

  • Design, build and evolve our AWS platform using Terraform as the single source of truth, while driving the gradual modernisation of our cloud landscape;

  • Build reusable infrastructure, deployment pipelines and platform tooling that enable engineering teams to ship independently and safely;

  • Introduce pragmatic cloud-native and event-driven solutions where they genuinely improve scalability, reliability and maintainability;

  • Make observability a default through standardised monitoring, logging, dashboards and alerting across the platform;

  • Improve deployment practices with automated CI/CD, progressive delivery and reliable rollback strategies;

  • Embed security, compliance and cost optimisation into the platform through automated guardrails and best practices;

  • Coach fellow engineers, review infrastructure and application code, and raise the overall cloud engineering bar through collaboration and example.

The responsibilities outlined above reflect how we currently envision this role. As we continue to grow and evolve, the scope and focus of the position may naturally change, influenced by your own ideas and insights. The way we work is built around the belief that everyone's input matters. If you see opportunities to improve the way we do things, or believe a process could be designed differently to achieve a better outcome, we encourage you to bring those ideas forward. Discuss them with your teammates, challenge the status quo, and help shape how we move forward together.

Why Luscii?

Read more about working at Luscii / OMRON and how we work as a team. Together, we are working on a mission to create space for care. Freedom, autonomy and ownership are of great importance in this. You are responsible for your own results and work according to the principles of Holacracy. Luscii is part of OMRON DH; together we built for the long term. To work on making healthcare better.

Most important benefits

  • Salary: Naturally, this depends on your background, experience, and relevant expertise. You may think of a maximum salary of approximately €86.000,- to €94.000,- per year for this position.

  • Remote-first: Work from anywhere in The Netherlands. We stay connected through monthly in-person team days called Assemblii.

  • Flexible setup: Create your own ideal workspace. Whatever works best for you - we’ve got you covered here.

The ideal candidate…

… probably doesn't exist, but if you can tick most of the checkboxes below, please apply! We are looking for someone who enjoys taking ownership of complex technical challenges, makes pragmatic engineering decisions, and is excited about helping others succeed along the way.

You know when to step up, when to involve colleagues and when to move forward decisively. Working independently does not mean working in isolation for you. You feel at ease being both a self-starter and a committed team player, contributing to shared goals while taking responsibility for your own domain. You value open communication, transparency, and mutual trust.

  • You have at least 6 years of experience building and operating large-scale cloud platforms, with deep hands-on AWS expertise and including the same amount of experience in senior-level ownership of modern cloud architectures;

  • You have extensive experience with Infrastructure as Code (Terraform) and treat infrastructure with the same rigour as application code;

  • You have a strong understanding of cloud-native, serverless and event-driven architectures, and the judgement to apply them pragmatically;

  • You know how to build reliable production systems with observability, automated deployments and safe release practices built in;

  • You enjoy modernising legacy platforms through incremental improvements rather than big-bang rewrites, while bringing others along in the process;

  • You have strong backend engineering experience, preferably with Node.js and TypeScript;

  • You are open to working in a Holacratic organization and curious about our way of organizing work, roles, and responsibilities;

  • English is our primary language for all internal communication at Luscii, so you're fluent in that language.

Interested? Apply now!

All interviews are conducted online and the entire procedure is planned in advance to keep momentum.

Flipp + Shopfully’s Product team focuses on driving adoption and revenue of our products by identifying the biggest market opportunities, building the case for investing in them, and shipping solutions with engineering, all while representing the voice of our merchant customers.

About the role

The Senior Product Manager is a senior, commercially minded product leader who already understands digital advertising. This role requires a strong strategic thinker with good business sense and solid hands-on product skills who leads opportunity identification, builds decision-ready business cases, and works with engineering to ship.

You will work closely with Sales, Engineering, Data, and Marketing teams across markets to align on key business objectives. By combining market insight, customer feedback, and industry trends, you will make sure our products resonate with merchants and drive growth. We’re looking for someone who can ramp up quickly and contribute independently.

WHAT YOU WILL DO 🏄

Market Understanding and Opportunity Identification

  • Work with Product Marketing, Sales Engineering and customer-facing teams to understand customer needs and prioritize the opportunities that matter most.
  • Find the highest-leverage areas to invest in, and weigh customer demand against our resources, capabilities and strategic direction.
  • Turn complex questions into clear priorities. For example: how do we create more value for retail partners as their strategies move toward e-commerce? How do we find and build opportunities at scale as products launch in new markets?

Business Cases and Strategy

  • Build business cases that size opportunities, weigh revenue trade-offs, and structure a clear recommendation so leadership can make a decision.
  • Own your recommendations, and be ready to explain them and adapt them as you learn.
  • Lead the strategy for how our products differentiate from competitors in the market.
  • Partner with Sales and Finance on pricing and monetization so our offering stays cohesive.

Product Discovery and Delivery

  • Lead discovery with merchants, advertisers, and internal teams to define problems worth solving.
  • Prioritise ruthlessly, balancing revenue impact, effort, and strategic fit.
  • Work hands-on with engineering to define requirements and ship, from alpha and testing through broad launch.
  • Partner with Sales and Marketing on launch timing and readiness, and run retrospectives on past launches to improve future ones.

Alignment and Stakeholder Management

  • Generate cross-functional alignment (Engineering, Data, Sales, Marketing, Content) with a shared focus on goals and timing.
  • Work across markets and levels of seniority, including senior leadership, with confidence.
  • Track progress and impact of product initiatives and communicate results clearly.
  • Build relationships with industry analysts, partners, and customers, and represent Flipp + Shopfully at conferences and industry events where relevant.

WHAT YOU WILL NEED🪄

Must-haves

  • Digital advertising foundations: supply vs. demand, how exchanges, SSPs, and DSPs work, programmatic bidding, pricing models (CPM, CPC, CPV), and fill rate and yield. Ideally gained in ad tech, a retail media network, a publisher, or a marketplace.
  • Proven experience building business cases: sizing opportunities, weighing revenue trade-offs, and structuring recommendations for decisions.
  • High autonomy: you figure things out, own the outcome and don’t need close management.
  • Genuine excitement about using AI tools and rethinking how work gets done.
  • Hands-on product skills: discovery, prioritisation, and working with engineering to ship, not only strategy.
  • Stakeholder management, with the confidence to work across markets and levels of seniority.
  • A scrappy, curious and confident approach. You’re hungry to make an impact.

HOURS ⏰
Your manager and several partner teams are in North America, so you’ll need to be flexible about working some later hours, beyond a standard 9-5 CET.

That’s why building a more diverse team, as well as bringing in even more talent, is so important for us.

  • Progress Over Perfection: We move forward. Always. In a fast-moving world, speed with purpose beats certainty without action. Momentum matters—not for its own sake, but because it drives results.

  • Technical authority in the account: You work with customer project management, IT, security, functional departments and works councils, you decide the technical questions, and you feed the gaps you see back into our product and engineering teams. What you bring to the table

Must-haves

  • Around 3 to 5 (or more) years in IT or tech consulting, customer engineering, forward deployed engineering, solutions engineering or SaaS implementation, with real enterprise exposure.

  • Hands-on experience with enterprise integration and identity: SSO and authentication (OIDC, OAuth, Entra ID or comparable), REST APIs and API-based integrations delivered inside real enterprise IT environments.

  • Customer-facing technical responsibility in enterprise projects, where you made the technical calls together with IT, security and functional departments rather than only coordinating them.

  • Genuine technical depth without being a full-time production developer: you read code, review a design, debug an integration and build a working prototype.

  • German at C1 level or above and fluent English.

  • Provisioning experience (SCIM) and integrations into HR or workforce systems such as SAP SuccessFactors, Workday or UKG.

  • An informed, current view on where agentic AI is heading: MCP, A2A, EMA and the authentication questions underneath them. We are looking for someone who follows the field closely and has an opinion, not for years of experience that cannot exist yet.

  • Prior work as a Customer Engineer or Forward Deployed Engineer at a product company, rather than in classic consulting only.

  • Workflow automation tooling (n8n or similar), comfort with logs, metrics and dashboards, or experience with German co-determination and enterprise data protection.

What we offer you

  • Work mode: We’re remote-first, giving you flexibility to work from home. At the same time, we deeply value the power of in-person collaboration. Depending on the role, you’ll join occasional team events, workshops, or meetings in our Berlin or Stuttgart offices - always with plenty of notice. The exact balance will be discussed during your interview.

  • Work-Life-Balance: We don't want you to grow roots to your desk chair. That's why we cover the costs of your E-Gym-Wellpass membership and offer job bike leasing.

  • Celebrating success: Expect highly motivated and committed people in a relaxed working atmosphere.

  • Be part of something bigger: You actively shape Flip AI in your role. Along the way, you are an enabler of the rapid growth process of a young tech company and grow towards your goals, fun is guaranteed.

  • Happy to be a Flipster: Stay tuned for regular team events and culture days that bring us together as Flipsters.

  • Working abroad: At Flip AI you can also work abroad in the European Union. Let's talk about remote work in the interview.

At Flip AI, everyone is welcome - no matter what gender you identify as or how old you are. Sexual identity, origin, religion, world view and disabilities do not influence your potential job at Flip AI. The most important thing is that YOU fit in!

title: RWE Biostatistician
description:
🏨 The company

Resilience Care is a leading French remote patient monitoring (RPM) company and a clinical research partner, founded in 2021 with a mission: better care.
We provide RPM solutions in oncology, gastroenterology and psychiatry, combining ePRO collection with AI techniques. Our platform supports healthcare professionals with early side‑effect detection for continuous and proactive care, and our patient mobile app helps measure and manage symptoms with tailored resources.
Our solutions improve care pathways, enrich continuous patient understanding, and accelerate clinical research through the collection, structuring and in‑depth analysis of real‑world data. They are currently deployed in routine care for 35,000 patients across 200+ healthcare institutions, and also support around twenty academic and industry clinical studies.
We put data at the service of care and therapeutic innovation, with the ambition to enable every patient to benefit from personalized medicine.

📝 Your role

In a nutshell: you will help build and deliver robust statistical work for Real‑World Evidence (RWE) and Medical Affairs studies — from analysis planning (SAP) to reproducible programming and clear interpretation.

Your impact: make study execution more reliable, faster and more reproducible (plans, code and reporting), enabling cross‑functional teams to make informed decisions.

Your day‑to‑day

  • Draft and/or contribute to Statistical Analysis Plans (SAP) and methodological documentation.

  • Program analyses in R and Python; concept of SQL/Postgre.

  • Contribute to RWE studies : design, methods and execution.

  • Set up data quality checks (consistency, cohort rules) and document assumptions.

  • Produce decision‑ready deliverables (tables/figures/reporting) and explain results to non‑statisticians (internal or external actors).

✨ Your team

  • Your future teammates: Dynamic team with medical and pharma expertise

  • Your manager: Nicoleta - Director Translational Research – RWE & Biostatistics

👤 Profile

  • ⚙️ You are a good fit if you can:

    • Apply biostatistics (survival analysis: Kaplan‑Meier, log‑rank, Cox; regression; GLM/GLMM; matching/weighting).

    • Write clean, reproducible code ( R, Python; basic SQL).

    • Work with patient healthcare data (quality, traceability, constraints).

    • Produce clear statistical/methodological documentation (protocole, SAPs, reports).

    • Build meaningful data visualisations.

    • Communicate insights to diverse audiences.

  • 🙂 You are a good fit if you have:

    • High methodological rigor and attention to detail.

    • Autonomy and ownership mindset.

    • Ability to prioritize and handle multiple studies in parallel.

    • Clear communication and collaborative approach.

    • Resilience when facing methodological push‑back.

  • 📃 You are a good fit if you have already:

    • 2–4 years of experience in biostatistics/RWE (CRO, consultancy or similar environments).

    • Delivered analyses on healthcare datasets.

    • Built reusable outputs (codebases, pipelines, reporting templates).

    • Worked closely with non‑technical stakeholders.

  • A plus if you:

    • Know good practices/guidelines (GxP, ICH E9/E9(R1)).

    • Have exposure to machine learning applied to healthcare data.

    • Have worked with external vendors (Pharma, CRO’s etc).

💛 Why join us?

  • High‑impact healthcare mission at the intersection of care, data and clinical research.

  • Broad scope: RWE, Medical Affairs studies, standardisation and automation.

  2. Manager interview (45 min): role expectations, methods and collaboration.

  3. Case study (45 min to 1 h): technical discussions and practical use cases with multiple interviewers.

title: Enterprise Account Executive
Senior Data Engineer
description:
About Orakl Oncology

At Orakl Oncology, we are accelerating the development of oncology treatments. Today, fewer than 5% of new cancer drugs succeed in clinical trials. Clearly, new methods are needed. We combine cutting-edge biology and AI to build the next generation of insight platforms with the world’s largest cohort of patient tumor avatars. These avatars fuel our AI-powered predictive engine, helping to anticipate clinical trial outcomes, validate therapies, and uncover new drug candidates. By generating multimodal, real-world data, we deliver insights that consistently outperform existing solutions.

Our mission is simple yet ambitious: to bring more effective treatments to patients who need them and to make drug development smarter, faster, and more personalized. We collaborate with top hospitals, research institutes, and pharmaceutical companies worldwide. Backed by leading investors, we are a fast-growing, mission-driven startup at the intersection of science and technology.

The role

We are looking for a curious engineering mind to lead the scaling of Orakl’s omics data within the Computational Biology team.

Every organoid grown in our lab is sequenced (WGS and RNA-seq). Our pipelines turn the raw reads into processed molecular profiles, and our models turn those profiles into clinical trial predictions, patient segments and new target candidates. Your mission will be to make omics data available to computational biologists and research engineers in a form they can build on. You will gather their needs and, in coordination with the Data & Infra team, design the data representations, storage layouts and access patterns that make model training and experimentation fast and reproducible. As our biobank expands, this will become a massive omics corpus that must efficiently serve client contracts, strategic partnerships and internal R&D projects.

Starting from processed omics data, you will assess how it is stored and served today, propose solutions to scale it, and drive their implementation, so our scientists and models can rely on it. You will build this hand in hand with our data engineering team, keeping our omics infrastructure consistent with the rest of the company’s stack. You will report to the Head of Computational Biology.

Experience with omics data is a strong plus, not a prerequisite. If you come from the conventional tabular data world and want to master data that is massive, multi-layered and regularly reprocessed, this role is built for you.

What you will do

  • Design and build the omics data architecture. Together with our data engineering team, define and evolve how omics data is stored as the corpus grows: what lives in a database, what stays in columnar files on S3, and how it all fits the company’s stack.

  • Guarantee reliable ingestion. Make sure every new batch of processed omics data (variant calls, expression, CNV, QC metrics, sample and sequencing tracking) lands reliably and consistently with our data model definition.

  • Build and maintain the omics data model. Maintain a curated reference layer as the single source of truth, keep model-ready datasets derived from it separate, and track lineage between the two so every model input can be traced back to its source.

  • Make the data easy to use. Build and evolve the access layer so scientists and models get what they need for client contracts, strategic partnerships and internal R&D, without writing joins or asking someone.

What you bring

Must-haves

  • 4+ years as a data engineer, with ingestion pipelines you built running in production.

  • Master’s in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Data Engineering (or equivalent experience)

  • Hands-on experience setting up and maintaining CI/CD for data pipelines and code libraries.

  • Strong data modeling experience: you have designed schemas that handle evolving identifiers, versioning and lineage.

  • Deep relational database expertise: schema design, partitioning, indexing, query plans, migrations on a live database.

  • Deep cloud infrastructure skills: AWS (S3 and core services), infrastructure as code (Terraform or equivalent) and containers (Docker), with sound judgment on what belongs in a database and what stays in files.

  • Strong experience in Python and SQL; comfortable with Git, CI and the command line.

  • You can propose architecture choices, defend them and converge with engineering peers.

  • A real drive to understand omics, including how our data is processed, so you can step in for our Senior Bioinformatician when they are away.

Nice-to-haves

  • Omics experience: you have loaded VCF/MAF files or expression matrices. Familiarity with Nextflow / nf-core pipelines.

  • Columnar formats and engines (Parquet, Arrow, DuckDB) and an orchestrator (Dagster, Airflow, Prefect).

  • Metabase or another BI layer on top of a relational database.

  • LIMS or biobank sample-tracking integration.

  • A tech-bio background, or prior work next to bioinformaticians.

What we offer

  • Mission: work in a cutting-edge environment, on the forefront of cancer research.

  • Role: be the engineer behind the data backbone of a distinctive oncology discovery platform — designing, with our data engineering team, how one of the world’s rarest PDO multi-omics and functional datasets is stored, served and scaled, so that scientists and models can build on it every day.

  • Impact: take ownership of a critical piece of an early-stage, fast-moving company, with the opportunity to shape it; your engineering decisions will carry through to our science and, ultimately, to patient outcomes.

  • Team: join a collaborative, multidisciplinary team where you’ll work alongside stellar clinicians, biologists, and engineers towards a common mission.

Interview Process

  1. Hiring Manager Call: Getting to know each other, aligning on expectations and context.

  2. Technical Deep Dive: A deep conversation on your experience with production data pipelines, data modeling, and scientific data processing.

  3. Technical Case: A system-design and problem-solving exercise representative of the real wet-lab data challenges you'll face at Orakl.

  4. Reference Call: A conversation with one or two people you've worked with closely.

  5. Founder Interview: A final discussion with our founders on vision, culture fit, and mutual ambitions.

Nous aidons les organisations à maîtriser leurs risques pour innover, en transformant des obligations réglementaires complexes (RGPD, IA) en processus simples, concrets et actionnables.

Le rôle

En tant que Data Migration Project Manager, tu pilotes les projets de migration des données clients vers Dastra, du cadrage jusqu'à la livraison.

À la croisée de la gestion de projet, de la data et du conseil client, ton rôle est majoritairement orienté pilotage et accompagnement client (environ 70 %), tout en étant suffisamment à l'aise avec la data et la technique pour comprendre, structurer et mapper les données.

  • Sécuriser chaque étape de la migration, de la préparation des données jusqu’à leur intégration dans Dastra

Comprendre & structurer la data

  • Définir et paramétrer les règles de transformation nécessaires à la migration

  • Contrôler les données tout au long du processus de migration

  • Comprendre la logique des scripts et des flux de données

The kind of deep, personalised health reading that could change this has been reserved for the few who could afford a 3,000€ check-up, and built for filing reports rather than changing lives.

We don't accept that.

Alan Precision is our bet on advanced prevention as the new norm of care. We combine biology, wearables, medical history, and lifestyle context, read it all as a connected system with AI supervised by physicians, and turn the result into a personalised protocol the member actually executes across sleep, nutrition, movement, stress, and supplementation. Then we retest, learn, and adapt. Health is a moving target. We move with it.

Our ambition: make Alan Precision the reference for advanced prevention in Europe by 2030.

⭐ The Founding Growth opportunity

Alan Precision is live, with fast week-over-week growth. Now we need to turn a new category into a habit: hundreds of thousands of customers in the coming years, and a measurable impact on their health. You will be the first growth and go-to-market person on the crew, accountable for two numbers: how many members subscribe to Precision, and how many stay, retest and renew.
