title: Research Software Engineering Intern (f/m/d)
description:
Description

QuantumDiamonds is building the world’s first commercial quantum sensing tools for chip failure analysis. As our Research Software Engineering Intern in Pre-Development, you bring our measurement software together. A measurement protocol is the recipe our Quantum Diamond Microscope (QDm) follows for one measurement: how laser, microwaves and camera are sequenced and timed, and how raw camera frames become a magnetic field image of a chip. Our engineers write new protocols whenever they test a new idea, and several backends for running them grew in parallel. You turn them into one shared Python framework that our engineers extend.

The challenge is a framework R&D still uses long after your internship: flexible enough that a new protocol is a day’s work, automated enough that a measurement runs without someone watching it, and structured enough that the next engineer extends it without reading all of it. An experienced colleague from the team mentors you and sets the architecture; you make that trade-off real in code, working with Claude Code every day, as our engineers do.

This is a full-time internship for 6 months, during or after your studies, starting as soon as possible.

Who we are

Founded in 2022 as a spin-off of TU Munich, QD leverages quantum sensors to rapidly capture three-dimensional current maps within multi-layer chips. Our strong, international team of over 70, including physicists, engineers, data scientists, and other experts, works side by side with major semiconductor manufacturers, supporting chip debugging and accelerating yield analysis. Backed by top-tier deep tech investors, semiconductor experts, and strategic public programs, we have ensured long-term stability, shifting from breakthrough to scale - and shaping the next chapter in chip testing.

Why join QuantumDiamonds?

Picture this:

  • Quantum sensors that see inside the most advanced chips on Earth, right where two frontier fields collide.

  • Nobel-Prize physics aimed at real customers with real problems, in production now, not someday.

  • Physicists, data scientists, and engineers building side by side, turning deep science into tools the industry actually runs on.

  • An international team that runs at hard problems for fun, where knowledge moves fast and so do you.

Still unsure about why joining us?

  • You'll get to build a company together with a brilliant and welcoming team on a product that has never been done before.

  • From Day 1, you'll own your own topics end to end and see the direct impact of your work on how the world sees QuantumDiamonds.

  • Our technology is the cutting edge of tomorrow, starting today and not in 10 years.

  • You’ll be part of a high-growth company backed by top-tier investors.

Let’s make the invisible visible!

 
 

What will you do

  • Bring the measurement software of Pre-Development together into one shared Python framework, to a target architecture your mentor defines, and migrate the existing measurement protocols onto it.

  • Keep the CI/CD pipeline on GitHub Actions healthy as the framework grows: tests, linting, packaging, releases.

  • Give first-pass reviews on pull requests from our engineers (tests, conventions, API conformance) before your mentor approves them.

  • Help our engineers extend the stack: new measurement protocols become modules in the framework, and you validate the migrated ones on our QDm systems together with them.

  • Document the framework and hand it over so the team runs it on its own after your internship.

 

What is expected of you

  • Enrolled in or recently graduated from a degree program in computer science, software engineering, computational engineering, physics or electrical engineering with a strong software focus.

  • Available full time for 6 months, starting as soon as possible.

  • Python is your working language: you structure packages, write type hints and tests, and have refactored or consolidated code you did not write.

  • Git and CI are routine for you, and you know how to make hardware-dependent code testable: mocked instruments, recorded data and simulation, with runs on real hardware as a separate stage.

  • AI coding agents are part of how you work, and you check their output the way you check your own.

  • You review code and take review well, you can agree on a common interface with engineers who each prefer their own solution, and you treat your colleagues as your users.

  • Fluent in English. On-site in Munich.

Experience with instrument control or lab automation in Python, with frameworks such as qudi, QCoDeS or PyMeasure, or contributions to open-source projects are a plus, not required. What we want you to bring is the patience to read code you did not write and the discipline to leave it better structured than you found it.

Our benefits

  • Mission: At QD, we’re driven by more than just building great products - we aim to make a lasting difference. Joining us means contributing to meaningful work that goes beyond business as usual.

  • Impact & growth: This is an exciting stage of our journey, and your voice matters. You’ll have the chance to shape our culture, influence key decisions, and grow alongside a company that’s scaling fast.

  • Mentoring: An experienced colleague from the team mentors you throughout your internship.

  • Health & fitness: With a company-sponsored Wellpass membership, you’ll have access to countless gyms, classes, and wellness offers across Germany to stay healthy and active.

  • Team & culture: We believe the best ideas come when we connect outside the office. From regular off-sites to team events, you’ll be part of a collaborative and supportive environment.

  • Well-being & balance: We value rest and recovery. That’s why you’ll enjoy 24 vacation days plus public holidays to recharge and return inspired.

About us

QuantumDiamonds GmbH, headquartered in Munich, Germany, develops and manufactures semiconductor inspection systems based on quantum sensing. Spun out of the Technical University of Munich in 2022, the company uses nitrogen-vacancy centers in diamond to map electrical current with micrometer precision inside advanced 2.5D and 3D chip architectures. Nine of the world's ten largest semiconductor manufacturers are engaged with QuantumDiamonds, with systems deployed across Europe, the United States, and Asia. The company is investing €152 million to build the world's first production facility for quantum sensing-based semiconductor inspection tools, supported under the European Chips Act.

  • Du verfügst über ausgezeichnete Deutschkenntnisse und hast Spaß daran, mit Menschen zu kommunizieren.

  • Du bist ehrgeizig, proaktiv und motiviert, messbare Ergebnisse zu erzielen.

  • Du hast kein Problem damit, auf fremde Menschen zuzugehen, Fragen zu stellen und mit Ablehnung umzugehen.

  • Du interessierst dich für KI, Startups und die Frage, wie Unternehmen wachsen.

  • Du arbeitest zuverlässig, eigenständig und möchtest dich kontinuierlich verbessern.

  • Erste Erfahrungen in Sales, Business Development, Recruiting, Consulting oder anderen kundenorientierten Tätigkeiten sind ein Plus, aber keine Voraussetzung.

Dein Ehrgeiz, deine Einstellung und deine Lernbereitschaft sind uns wichtiger als deine bisherige Erfahrung oder deine Noten.

Warum Helix?

Lerne einen der wertvollsten Skills im Geschäftsleben.
Egal, ob du später selbst gründen, ins Consulting gehen oder eine Karriere im Vertrieb aufbauen möchtest: Die Fähigkeit, überzeugend zu kommunizieren, zu verhandeln und zu verkaufen, wird dir immer einen entscheidenden Vorteil verschaffen.

Bei Helix lernst du durch praktische Erfahrung. Du sprichst mit echten Entscheidern, verstehst, wie Unternehmen Kaufentscheidungen treffen, und erlebst aus erster Hand, wie aus einem ersten Gespräch ein zahlender Kunde wird.

Wachse mit dem Unternehmen.
Wir bauen unseren Vertrieb von Grund auf auf. Das bedeutet, dass du die Möglichkeit hast, Prozesse mitzugestalten, neue Strategien zu testen und Verantwortung zu übernehmen, für die du in einem größeren Unternehmen normalerweise deutlich länger brauchen würdest.

Deine Leistung bestimmt deine Möglichkeiten.
Wir suchen Menschen, die lernen und Verantwortung übernehmen wollen. Wenn du konstant gute Ergebnisse lieferst, bekommst du die Möglichkeit, über die reine Kundenakquise hinauszuwachsen, eigene Verkaufsgespräche zu führen und Deals abzuschließen.

Wisse, worauf du dich einlässt.

Gleichzeitig entwickelst du dadurch Durchhaltevermögen, Selbstbewusstsein und die Fähigkeit, andere Menschen zu überzeugen – Fähigkeiten, die dich dein gesamtes Berufsleben begleiten werden.

So bewirbst du dich

Wir suchen keinen perfekten Lebenslauf und erwarten keine jahrelange Berufserfahrung.

Wenn du ehrgeizig bist, Herausforderungen magst und lernen möchtest, wie man erfolgreich verkauft, freuen wir uns darauf, dich kennenzulernen.

title: Junior Engine Control System & Monitoring Engineer
description:
Here at The Exploration Company, we are building spacecrafts for humanity.

About The Exploration Company

At The Exploration Company, we are developing, producing and operating Nyx, a modular and reusable orbital space vehicle that aims to eventually be refuelled in orbit, carrying cargo and potentially humans in the long run. The heart of a spacecraft lies in its engine, which is why we develop our own propulsion systems, aiming for the highest level of efficiency and reliability.

Role Summary

We are seeking a Junior Engine Control System & Monitoring Engineer to join the engine control and monitoring team of Storm, our high-thrust LOX/LCH4 cryogenic rocket engine. Working alongside senior control engineers, you will develop and test control and monitoring algorithms, work with the engine functional models provided by the functional team, contribute to setting up the controller development environment, and help verify the controller through Model-, Software- and Hardware-in-the-Loop testing and during engine test campaigns. This is an entry-level, hands-on role for a recent graduate with strong control fundamentals who wants to learn on real hardware and progressively grow into full ownership of safety-critical engine control functions.

Key responsibilities:

1. Control & Monitoring Algorithm Development

• Design and implement engine control and monitoring algorithms, following the software team's rules, guidelines and auto-coding practices.

• Contribute to the definition of the engine regulation strategy (thrust and mixture ratio control, chill-down, start-up and shutdown transients) together with functional and system engineers.

• Support the definition of control and monitoring requirements for engine subsystems (valves, pumps, sensors, controller, software).

2. Simulation & Controller Development Environment

• Contribute to setting up the controller development environment: toolchain, model and code configuration management, auto-coding chain, and the MiL/SiL/HiL simulation and test infrastructure.

• Integrate the engine functional models delivered by the functional team (turbopumps, valves, combustion devices, cryogenic feed lines; steady-state, transient and chill-down) into the control design and simulation environment, deriving simplified or linearised models for controller synthesis where needed.

• Run closed-loop simulations to assess controller performance, stability margins and robustness to model uncertainties.

• Feed test results back to the functional team to support model correlation, and flag model limitations that matter for control.

3. Health Monitoring & Fault Management

• Contribute to the engine monitoring strategy that assesses the health status of the engine and its subsystems (combustion chamber, turbopumps, valves…).

• Implement fault detection and sensor validation logic for both real-time protection and post-test analysis.

• Support failure mode analyses (FMEA) and the management of failure modes, paving the way for engine reusability.

4. Validation, Testing & Documentation

• Prepare and run Model-, Software- and Hardware-in-the-Loop (MiL, SiL, HiL) test campaigns to verify the control and monitoring functions at each step, from Simulink model to embedded code on target hardware.

• Support Storm engine and component cryogenic (LOX/LCH4) test campaigns: test preparation, on-site support, data processing and post-test analysis.

• Produce clear development documentation: specifications, test procedures, test reports and justification files.

What we would love to see from you:

• Master's degree (or equivalent) in Aerospace, Electrical, Control or Mechanical Engineering, or a related technical discipline.

• Recent graduate (or graduating within the next months); no professional experience required. A master's thesis, internship or academic project in control, propulsion or embedded systems is a strong plus.

• Solid fundamentals in control theory, both classical and modern (state-space, robustness, digital control).

• Practical use of MATLAB/Simulink and Python through coursework or projects; basic knowledge of C/C++.

• Basic understanding of fluid dynamics and thermodynamics, and a strong interest in cryogenic propulsion and turbomachinery.

• Fluent in English.

Nice to Have:

• Exposure to MiL/SiL/HiL testing or real-time embedded systems.

• Experience with auto-coding from Simulink models.

• Familiarity with safety-critical design practices, reliability engineering or failure mode analysis.

• Interest or experience in data science applied to health monitoring and anomaly detection.

• Knowledge of space standards (ECSS, MIL-STD, NASA-HBK…).

• German and/or French.

Skills & Behaviours:

• Eagerness to learn and to take on increasing ownership under the guidance of senior engineers.

• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, including the ability to draw useful conclusions from partial or contradictory data.

• Clear oral and written communication; comfortable working closely with engine, avionics, software and test teams.

• Behaviour consistent with The Exploration Company's core values of Mission, Vision, Integrity, Excellence and Teamwork.

title: Working Student - LLM Quantization & Inference Performance
description:
About Tensordyne (formerly Recogni)

AI is transforming our world. It can perform cognitive functions that previously only humans could do, such as perceiving interactions across different modalities and environments - with the ability to quickly learn and then solve complex problems. Tensordyne is an AI system solution company that builds very high-performance, low-power generative AI inference systems. Our mission, through the creation of custom silicon, hardware and software, is to enable multimodal Generative AI inference acceleration at scale, with safe, sustainable, high-performance systems for our hyperscaler and neocloud data center customers. We are at the leading edge of advancing the latest research and product improvements for generative Al inference solutions that will make Al even more advantageous for compelling new generative AI applications.Tensordyne is a well funded, fast-paced startup company with headquarters in both Sunnyvale, CA, and Munich, Germany. We also have many talented team members working remotely across North America and Europe. We take care of our people and their families with comprehensive benefits, competitive compensation, flexible spending options, and recognition programs, because building category-defining technology starts with a healthy, supported team. Come join us as we shape the future of multimodal generative artificial intelligence!

Role summary

How much numerical precision does an LLM need, and where in the model architecture does it matter most? When does quantization improve runtime, and what does it cost in model quality?

We're looking for a motivated working student to help turn these questions into experiments and experiments into maintainable code. You'll explore optimization methods and build reusable evaluation tooling. You'll work closely with our quantization, compiler, and runtime engineers, and your findings will directly influence how we optimize models for Tensordyne hardware.

What you will do

  • Model quality evaluation: Measure how low-precision computation affects performance on coding and reasoning benchmarks. Diagnose where quantization has the greatest impact.
  • Quantization research: Implement and compare post-training quantization methods to improve inference efficiency while preserving task accuracy.
  • Build reproducible tooling: Automate evaluations, track configurations and results, and make experiments accessible to engineers and AI agents.
  • Measure runtime performance: Characterize latency, throughput, and memory usage to understand bottlenecks under different deployment scenarios.

A first project could involve exploring the quality–performance Pareto frontier of a Qwen or LlaMa model. You'll experiment with 16-bit, 8-bit, and 4-bit quantization configurations to find the best runtime-quality tradeoff.

Core qualifications

  • Current enrollment in Computer Science, Mathematics, Electrical Engineering, Machine Learning, or a related master's degree program.
  • Strong Python and PyTorch skills, including the ability to understand and modify model implementations.
  • Effective use of AI coding tools and critical review of their output.
  • An experimental mindset: you can formulate hypotheses, design comparisons, and draw careful conclusions from noisy results.
  • Clear communication and the ability to present experimental findings and technical tradeoffs to the team.

Strong pluses: experience with quantization, LLM evaluation, performance profiling, or inference optimization.

This role is for you if you thrive on responsibility, learn quickly, and are naturally proactive.

What we offer

Join a deep-tech team building the next generation of AI inference systems. Put your university knowledge into practice with leading open-source LLMs, deepen your understanding of quantization and inference optimization, and build skills in experimental design, software engineering, and AI coding tools. You'll own a focused project, receive close mentorship from experienced engineers, and have room to explore ideas that shape our optimization methods.

Tensordyne's culture was built on the following values

  • Put people first. We only succeed when our people succeed.
  • Ethics and integrity always. Be open, honest, and respectful of everyone.
  • Think Big. Be ambitious and have audacious goals.
  • Aim for excellence. Quality and excellence count in everything we do.
  • Own it and get it done. Results matter!
  • Make each person better together than they would be as an individual.
  • Embrace each other's differences, and embrace that there will be differences.

Glance is owned and operated by Glance InMobi Pte. Ltd., a non-consolidated subsidiary of InMobi Pte. Ltd. To learn more, visit advertising.inmobi.com.

Glance

InMobi is seeking a passionate, ambitious, and driven Senior Sales Manager to drive new logo activation for InMobi's App Performance Solutions team across the DACH region and broader EMEA market. In this role, you'll be responsible for identifying, engaging, and closing high-value opportunities with some of the largest brands across non-gaming verticals. This is a high-impact, quota-carrying role ideal for a self-starter who thrives in a fast-paced, data-driven environment and is passionate about helping performance marketers scale through programmatic app advertising.

You'll join a high-performing team spanning EMEA Sales, Client Growth, and Media Buying under App Performance Solutions — a team that will actively support your growth and success within the InMobi programmatic sales ecosystem. This is an exciting opportunity to make a visible impact across the EMEA region for a high-growth App Performance Solutions business comprising an AI/ML-driven DSP, Owned and Operated Glance TV, and Performance CTV.

This is a role for true hunters — those who thrive on building pipelines from scratch, opening doors others can't, and turning cold conversations into long-term revenue partnerships.

This is a fully remote role based in Germany. Proficiency in both German and English is required. Some travel is expected for client meetings, industry events, and in-person team sync-ups as needed.

The Impact You'll Make: 

As Senior Sales Manager, EMEA, you will be responsible for driving sales from a portfolio of Direct Brands and Performance Agencies across the DACH region by creating and selling effective App Performance Solutions. You will also actively participate in shaping InMobi's App Performance sales strategy, go-to-market approach, and execution plan across your key region within EMEA.

  • Identify, acquire, advise, and develop new relationships with targeted, strategic brands, agencies, and partners that ensure the growth and long-term success of InMobi's suite of App Performance Solutions
  • Leverage your knowledge of the market landscape and InMobi's unique selling propositions and differentiators to develop new and enduring business with advertisers — including navigating the Programmatic and walled garden ecosystems to position InMobi App Performance Solutions as a must-have for brands' app growth and retention strategies
  • Maintain strong relationships with ecosystem influencers, MMPs, agencies, and partners to keep InMobi top of mind for their clients
  • Own the entire sales lifecycle — from outbound prospecting and inbound lead qualification to proposal building, nurturing, activation, and strategic growth consulting
  • Collaborate closely with cross-functional teams across Client Growth, Media Buying, Legal, Finance, Ecosystem Partnerships, and Product to ensure seamless onboarding, execution, and account handover to the Growth team
  • Represent InMobi App Performance Solutions at key industry events, conferences, and networking opportunities across EMEA to drive visibility and pipeline growth
  • Maintain a disciplined approach to pipeline management, leveraging CRM tools for accurate forecasting and performance tracking
  • Consistently exceed quarterly revenue targets through strategic account acquisition and strong client relationship management

The Experience We Need: 

  • Industry experience. You bring 5+ years of hunting and selling experience to App businesses and Performance Agencies. You understand the challenges they face, can leverage your experience to develop compelling solutions, and have a track record of consistently meeting and exceeding revenue goals. You're known for building revenue where none existed — not just maintaining books of business, but creating them.
  • An advertising technology expert. You've spent at least 6+ years in ad tech and know the EMEA ecosystem well. Experience at a leading Performance DSP, Performance CTV, Ad Network, Rewarded Platform, MMP, or other online advertising company is required. You think deeply about clients' growth and retention challenges and know how to recommend the right solutions.
  • A trusted advisor and consultant. You have authentic communication skills and the ability to form consultative, credible, and long-standing relationships with your clients. In a marketplace flooded with vendors, your clients think of you first — not because you sold them, but because you solved for them.
  • A high-energy, passionate self-starter. You are highly self-motivated by nature, ambition is in your DNA, and you are extremely comfortable in a fast-paced, risk-taking, and often ambiguous environment.
  • Analytically strong and a compelling storyteller. You have strong analytical skills and the ability to peel back layers and find hidden opportunities. You don't just present numbers — you build narratives around them that move clients to action.
  • A proactive problem solver. You have a proven ability to solve customer pain points and technical challenges while proactively creating solutions through cross-functional collaboration.
  • Eager, curious, and a fast learner. You are naturally inquisitive, take a proactive approach, and seek out ways to support your colleagues. The ad tech landscape shifts constantly — signal loss, AI disruption, shifting buyer behaviour — and you lean in rather than wait for the dust to settle.
  • Education. A BA/BS degree in a relevant discipline is required, or equivalent professional experience. An MBA or Master's degree is a plus.
  • Language. Full professional proficiency in both German and English is required. 

At InMobi, you'll be surrounded by people who:

  • Think big and act fast — we're entrepreneurial, thrive in ambiguity, and love solving high-impact problems
  • Are passionate, fanatically driven, and take immense pride in their work — we care deeply about the impact we create and continuously push our potential
  • Own their outcomes — we take responsibility, make bold decisions, and execute with confidence
  • Embrace freedom with accountability — we value autonomy and understand that trust comes with responsibility
  • Believe in lifelong learning — we welcome feedback, challenge ourselves to grow, and aren't afraid to take smart risks

title: Senior Sales Manager - EMEA
description:
InMobi (Corporate)

InMobi Group is a global technology company shaping the future of agentic commerce and advertising. Through its ecosystem of businesses — including InMobi Advertising and flagship consumer platform Glance — InMobi leverages data, machine learning, and generative AI to help brands reach audiences more precisely and consumers discover products more intuitively. Glance, which is pioneering new models of agentic commerce, is owned and operated by Glance InMobi Pte. Ltd., a non-consolidated subsidiary of InMobi Pte. Ltd.

InMobi Advertising

InMobi Advertising, part of global technology company InMobi, is an agentic advertising platform helping brands and merchants achieve their business outcomes. Through its proprietary intelligence, AI-led solutions, and vast consumer reach — including flagship consumer platform Glance — InMobi Advertising delivers the omnichannel performance defining what's next in advertising and commerce. Glance is owned and operated by Glance InMobi Pte. Ltd., a non-consolidated subsidiary of InMobi Pte. Ltd. To learn more, visit advertising.inmobi.com.

Glance

Glance is an intelligent shopping agent, redefining the commerce experience. Powered by proprietary agentic intelligence and generative AI, Glance delivers a hyper-personalized consumer experience across mobile and TV — shaping the new era of shopping. Glance is operated by Glance InMobi Pte. Ltd., a non-consolidated subsidiary of global technology leader InMobi, and is backed by Mithril Capital, Google and Jio Platforms. To learn more, visit glance.com.

Overview of the Role:

InMobi is seeking a passionate, ambitious, and driven Senior Sales Manager to drive new logo activation for InMobi's App Performance Solutions team across the DACH region and broader EMEA market. In this role, you'll be responsible for identifying, engaging, and closing high-value opportunities with some of the largest brands across non-gaming verticals. This is a high-impact, quota-carrying role ideal for a self-starter who thrives in a fast-paced, data-driven environment and is passionate about helping performance marketers scale through programmatic app advertising.

You'll join a high-performing team spanning EMEA Sales, Client Growth, and Media Buying under App Performance Solutions — a team that will actively support your growth and success within the InMobi programmatic sales ecosystem. This is an exciting opportunity to make a visible impact across the EMEA region for a high-growth App Performance Solutions business comprising an AI/ML-driven DSP, Owned and Operated Glance TV, and Performance CTV.

This is a role for true hunters — those who thrive on building pipelines from scratch, opening doors others can't, and turning cold conversations into long-term revenue partnerships.

This is a fully remote role based in Germany. Proficiency in both German and English is required. Some travel is expected for client meetings, industry events, and in-person team sync-ups as needed.

The Impact You'll Make: 

As Senior Sales Manager, EMEA, you will be responsible for driving sales from a portfolio of Direct Brands and Performance Agencies across the DACH region by creating and selling effective App Performance Solutions. You will also actively participate in shaping InMobi's App Performance sales strategy, go-to-market approach, and execution plan across your key region within EMEA.

  • Identify, acquire, advise, and develop new relationships with targeted, strategic brands, agencies, and partners that ensure the growth and long-term success of InMobi's suite of App Performance Solutions
  • Leverage your knowledge of the market landscape and InMobi's unique selling propositions and differentiators to develop new and enduring business with advertisers — including navigating the Programmatic and walled garden ecosystems to position InMobi App Performance Solutions as a must-have for brands' app growth and retention strategies
  • Maintain strong relationships with ecosystem influencers, MMPs, agencies, and partners to keep InMobi top of mind for their clients
  • Own the entire sales lifecycle — from outbound prospecting and inbound lead qualification to proposal building, nurturing, activation, and strategic growth consulting
  • Collaborate closely with cross-functional teams across Client Growth, Media Buying, Legal, Finance, Ecosystem Partnerships, and Product to ensure seamless onboarding, execution, and account handover to the Growth team
  • Represent InMobi App Performance Solutions at key industry events, conferences, and networking opportunities across EMEA to drive visibility and pipeline growth
  • Maintain a disciplined approach to pipeline management, leveraging CRM tools for accurate forecasting and performance tracking
  • Consistently exceed quarterly revenue targets through strategic account acquisition and strong client relationship management

The Experience We Need: 

  • Industry experience. You bring 5+ years of hunting and selling experience to App businesses and Performance Agencies. You understand the challenges they face, can leverage your experience to develop compelling solutions, and have a track record of consistently meeting and exceeding revenue goals. You're known for building revenue where none existed — not just maintaining books of business, but creating them.
  • An advertising technology expert. You've spent at least 6+ years in ad tech and know the EMEA ecosystem well. Experience at a leading Performance DSP, Performance CTV, Ad Network, Rewarded Platform, MMP, or other online advertising company is required. You think deeply about clients' growth and retention challenges and know how to recommend the right solutions.
  • A trusted advisor and consultant. You have authentic communication skills and the ability to form consultative, credible, and long-standing relationships with your clients. In a marketplace flooded with vendors, your clients think of you first — not because you sold them, but because you solved for them.
  • A high-energy, passionate self-starter. You are highly self-motivated by nature, ambition is in your DNA, and you are extremely comfortable in a fast-paced, risk-taking, and often ambiguous environment.
  • Analytically strong and a compelling storyteller. You have strong analytical skills and the ability to peel back layers and find hidden opportunities. You don't just present numbers — you build narratives around them that move clients to action.
  • A proactive problem solver. You have a proven ability to solve customer pain points and technical challenges while proactively creating solutions through cross-functional collaboration.
  • Eager, curious, and a fast learner. You are naturally inquisitive, take a proactive approach, and seek out ways to support your colleagues. The ad tech landscape shifts constantly — signal loss, AI disruption, shifting buyer behaviour — and you lean in rather than wait for the dust to settle.
  • Education. A BA/BS degree in a relevant discipline is required, or equivalent professional experience. An MBA or Master's degree is a plus.
  • Language. Full professional proficiency in both German and English is required. 

At InMobi, you'll be surrounded by people who:

  • Think big and act fast — we're entrepreneurial, thrive in ambiguity, and love solving high-impact problems
  • Are passionate, fanatically driven, and take immense pride in their work — we care deeply about the impact we create and continuously push our potential
  • Own their outcomes — we take responsibility, make bold decisions, and execute with confidence
  • Embrace freedom with accountability — we value autonomy and understand that trust comes with responsibility
  • Believe in lifelong learning — we welcome feedback, challenge ourselves to grow, and aren't afraid to take smart risks

Our compensation philosophy enables us to provide a competitive salary that drives high performance while balancing business needs and pay equity. We determine compensation based on a wide variety of factors, including role, nature of experience, skills, and location.

title: Account Executive
description:
Who are we

At Lokalise, we make it easy and profitable for businesses to expand into new markets. Our AI-powered localization platform helps companies manage both software and marketing content from a single, unified environment — ensuring every team speaks with one voice across every language and channel.

By automating workflows, integrating with over 60 tools, and centralizing translation memory and terminology, Lokalise enables product, engineering, and marketing teams to collaborate without friction and launch globally up to 10× faster and at 80% lower cost.

Trusted by thousands of businesses across more than 100 countries, Lokalise empowers millions of people worldwide to use digital services in their native languages. Backed by a customer-loved support team, our platform fits seamlessly into your design, development, and content workflows, helping you scale with consistency and control.

Location

While our company operates exclusively on a remote basis, you must reside and have the legal right to work in one of the following countries: the United Kingdom, Latvia, or Spain.

* This is a full-time, remote position. Please note that we do not engage on a B2B or contractor basis. 

* We do not partner with search firms.

 

About The Role

We are looking for an Account Executive to join our EMEA sales team and help drive Lokalise's growth across one of our most commercially significant segments.

The customers you'll engage span a broad range of industries across EMEA — from high-growth tech companies and digital-native brands to more established businesses undergoing meaningful transformation. These are companies at genuine inflection points: some are taking their first structured steps into localisation, moving away from fragmented, agency-reliant processes; others are further along, looking to consolidate tooling, automate workflows end-to-end, and unlock the full potential of AI-assisted translation at scale.

AI is increasingly at the centre of these conversations. Prospects want to understand how intelligent automation can accelerate time-to-market, reduce manual review cycles, and enable their teams to scale content globally without scaling headcount — and you'll be equipped to lead those conversations with real credibility, backed by a platform that is purpose-built for this moment in the industry.

Reporting into EMEA Sales leadership, you'll own the full sales cycle from prospecting to close, collaborating closely with Sales Development, Marketing, and Customer Success to position Lokalise as a trusted, long-term partner for growth.

 

What You Will Do 

  • Manage the full sales cycle: From prospecting and identifying qualified leads to delivering compelling product demonstrations, navigating proof-of-concept processes, and negotiating contracts.
  • Engage prospects: Position and articulate Lokalise's value proposition to key decision-makers, ensuring alignment with their business needs and objectives.
  • Build a robust pipeline: Commit to daily targeted outbound prospecting to consistently maintain a strong pipeline of opportunities.
  • Collaborate with internal teams: Partner with Product, Customer Success, and Marketing to ensure a seamless customer journey and tailor solutions to prospect needs.
  • Exceed sales targets: Consistently achieve or exceed monthly and quarterly revenue quotas while driving long-term relationships with customers.
  • Track and report sales activities: Maintain up-to-date records in Salesforce and provide accurate forecasting and account planning.
  • Stay informed: Continuously educate yourself on Lokalise's products, the localisation industry, and competitive landscape to effectively position our solutions.


What You Must Have 

  • Proven sales experience: 3+ years of B2B SaaS sales experience, preferably managing complex sales cycles with mid-market and enterprise clients.
  • Track record of success: Demonstrable history of meeting or exceeding quotas and closing new business.
  • Outbound prospecting and pipeline generation: Proven ability to proactively identify and engage target accounts, generate your own pipeline through outbound outreach, and turn cold prospects into qualified opportunities. You're comfortable taking ownership of prospecting rather than relying primarily on inbound leads or SDR-generated pipeline.
  • Experience selling to Marketing teams: A track record of selling SaaS solutions to Marketing audiences. Given the technical complexity of our product, experience engaging with technical stakeholders and navigating product-focused conversations is also a plus.
  • Sales methodology expertise: Familiarity with methodologies like SPICED, MEDDIC, or similar frameworks.
  • Strong communication skills: Excellent verbal and written communication abilities, with the capability to engage and influence multiple stakeholders.
  • Technical aptitude: Comfortable with tools like Salesforce, Gong, and LinkedIn Sales Navigator, and able to quickly learn new technologies.
  • Resilient and proactive mindset: A self-starter who thrives in a fast-paced, target-driven environment and is motivated to drive urgency and outcomes.

 

It's a Plus If You Have 

  • Experience selling localisation or translation management solutions.
  • Knowledge of the SaaS market and a strong grasp of B2B sales processes.
  • Familiarity with outbound sales tools such as Outreach or Salesloft.
  • Experience working with distributed or remote teams.

 

Our Benefits

💰 Competitive salary and employee stock options.
🌍 Fully remote setup with flexible working hours.
🏢 Co-working budget — for those days you want a change from your home office.
🌴 Flexible vacation policy to recharge when you need to.
🖥️ Home office setup budget — monitor, desk, ergonomics, whatever helps you do your best work.
📚 Learning & development budget to grow your skills and career.
🏥 Health insurance to keep you covered.
🧘 Wellness allowance to support your mental and physical well-being.
🤝 Great startup culture — remote but close-knit, with regular retreats and social events to stay connected.

We are committed to a culture of inclusion and equal opportunities. Therefore, we welcome applications from people of all gender identities, sexual orientations, personal expressions, relationship, marital, or civil partnership statuses, racial identities, national or ethnic origins, religious beliefs, ages, and disability statuses.

description:
Our Global Structure


Deliveroo is now part of DoorDash, bringing together teams with even greater reach, scale, and ambition. Depending on your role, you may collaborate with teammates, systems, and leaders across DoorDash and Wolt. Together, we're unlocking new possibilities as one global team.

Join us in our mission to transform the way people shop and eat, where impact, innovation and growth drive everything we do. Our People team are the architects of a great workplace where brilliant minds come together to do their best work. From discovering diverse talent and nurturing future leaders, to creating spaces that spark collaboration and crafting rewards that celebrate success—we're passionate about building a culture where everyone can thrive.

We're looking for a Senior HR Advisor to join our Manchester team. This is a hybrid role. You'll help us deliver a fair, consistent and high-performing employee experience by leading complex employee relations, strengthening manager capability and using people insights to improve how we work across our Merchant organisation.

Get to know our People team—what drives us, how we work and what you can expect.

What You'll Be Doing

You'll be joining the UKI People team, primarily supporting our Merchant organisation. Employee relations sits at the heart of the role, alongside a broader focus on employee experience, operational excellence and continuous improvement.

Employee Relations and Case Management

  • Manage a varied and complex end-to-end caseload across performance, probation, absence, grievances and disciplinaries.
  • Provide clear, practical advice that balances employee experience, commercial needs, employment law and organisational risk.
  • Build trusted relationships with managers, helping them address concerns early and confidently challenging where needed to achieve fair and consistent outcomes.
  • Respond to sensitive employee and manager concerns with sound judgement, discretion and professionalism, ensuring issues are resolved or escalated appropriately.
  • Maintain accurate and timely case documentation, delivering a consistently high standard of support across competing priorities.

Employee Experience and Engagement

  • Partner with managers, leaders, and People colleagues to create an environment where employees feel heard, valued and supported.
  • Use employee feedback, case themes and engagement insights to identify emerging concerns and opportunities to improve the employee experience.
  • Support feedback channels and targeted engagement activity, ensuring themes are followed through and actions are clearly communicated.
  • Coach managers on the behaviours and everyday practices that influence engagement, performance and retention.

Root-Cause Analysis and Process Improvement

  • Use case data, employee feedback and people trends to identify hotspots and underlying factors, such as onboarding, management capability or gaps in existing processes.
  • Turn insights into practical interventions that reduce avoidable cases and improve employee and manager experiences.
  • Recommend continuous improvements to People policies, guidance and processes, helping us deliver support with greater consistency and efficiency.
  • Identify recurring employee or manager questions and improve the guidance, tools and self-service resources available to them.

Manager Capability and Coaching

  • Coach and upskill managers through sensitive people matters, helping them build the confidence and judgement to handle issues effectively.
  • Deliver practical sessions on employee relations policies, UK employment legislation and effective people management.
  • Guide managers towards the right People tools and resources, encouraging greater self-sufficiency while remaining available for complex or higher-risk situations.
  • Communicate complex processes and decisions clearly to a range of audiences, adapting your approach to the situation and the people involved.

People Partnering and Strategic Support

  • Partner with leaders across our Merchant organisation, building a strong understanding of their teams, priorities and people challenges.
  • Support core People processes, including performance calibrations, engagement activity and organisational change.
  • Use data and people insights to support leadership discussions and inform practical, evidence-based decisions.
  • Contribute to targeted UKI People projects and work collaboratively across the wider People team to deliver meaningful improvements.

What You'll Need to Thrive

Essential

  • Significant experience managing complex end-to-end employee relations cases within a fast-paced environment, backed by up-to-date knowledge of UK employment law.
  • Strong advisory and coaching capability, with a proven ability to constructively challenge managers and balance commercial risk with employee experience.
  • Sound judgement and the confidence to navigate sensitive or ambiguous situations with limited direction.
  • An analytical mindset, with experience using case data, employee feedback and people trends to identify root causes and deliver proactive HR solutions.
  • Strong organisational skills and attention to detail, including the ability to maintain accurate documentation, meet deadlines and deliver consistently across multiple priorities.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to explain complex or sensitive information clearly to a range of audiences.
  • A high level of discretion and professionalism when handling confidential employee information.
  • A collaborative and adaptable approach, with experience building trusted partnerships across teams and influencing without direct authority.
  • Confidence using HR systems and digital tools to manage work, identify insights and improve the employee and manager experience.

Nice to Have

  • Experience supporting commercial, operational or technology-led business units.
  • Broader exposure to, or an interest in, HR Business Partnering and organisational design.
  • Experience supporting employee listening, engagement or retention initiatives.
  • Experience improving HR guidance, self-service tools or digital processes to increase adoption and make support easier to access.
  • Familiarity with people analytics or AI-enabled tools and an interest in how emerging technology can improve HR decision-making and operational efficiency.

Why Join Us?

At Deliveroo, you'll do work that matters, solving real-world problems in a three-sided marketplace that's constantly evolving.

We're food lovers, problem solvers, community builders and more, brought together by a shared drive to make things better. Working here, you can expect to:

  • 🔧 Make a visible impact every day
    Your work directly improves experiences for customers, partners and riders.
  • 🌱 Learn fast in an entrepreneurial environment
    Work close to the market with autonomy, pace and real responsibility.
  • 🧠 Build a career, not just a role
    Stretch yourself, develop new skills and grow as the business evolves.
  • 🌎 Deliver together in an inclusive culture
    Join collaborative, values-driven teams that support you to do your best work.

At Deliveroo, we know that a great workplace reflects the world around us and that true diversity and inclusion make us stronger, more creative, and better at what we do. We're committed to fostering an environment where everyone can do their best work and feel they belong.

title: Staff Software Engineer, Event Streaming Systems
description:
Our Global Structure


Deliveroo is now part of DoorDash, bringing together teams with even greater reach, scale, and ambition. Depending on your role, you may collaborate with teammates, systems, and leaders across DoorDash and Wolt. Together, we're unlocking new possibilities as one global team.

Join us in our mission to transform the way people shop and eat, where impact, innovation and growth drive everything we do.

Our Engineering teams tackle complex technical challenges across a global, three-sided marketplace, building and scaling systems that serve millions of customers, riders and merchants every day. From real-time logistics to resilient infrastructure and marketplace optimisation, we design, build and operate technology that powers Deliveroo's (& Doordash's) growth at scale.

We're looking for a Staff Software Engineer to join our Event Streaming Systems team. This is a hybrid role.

In this role, you'll provide technical leadership for the event streaming infrastructure that powers business-critical workflows across Deliveroo, DoorDash and Wolt. You'll help define the long-term direction of our messaging and streaming platforms, lead high-impact technical initiatives across teams, and raise the reliability, scalability and operational excellence bar for Tier-0 infrastructure.

What You'll Be Doing

You'll be joining the Event Streaming Systems team within the broader Storage organisation. The team builds and operates highly reliable, scalable and efficient event streaming infrastructure, including Kafka, Event Streaming abstractions (internally called EventBus), messaging platform capabilities, and future streaming technologies. The team also partners closely with Database Reliability, Storage, SRE, Data Platform and Core Infrastructure teams to ensure our most critical data and messaging systems remain reliable, operable and cost-efficient at global scale.

These systems support Tier-0 workflows and are foundational to how engineering teams build reliable, event-driven products at scale.

Here's what your day-to-day might look like:

  • Define and drive the technical vision and roadmap for our event streaming and messaging platforms, balancing reliability, scalability, cost, operability and developer experience.
  • Lead team-level and cross-team initiatives for Kafka, EventBus and related streaming infrastructure, from ambiguous problem definition through architecture, delivery, rollout and adoption.
  • Act as a trusted technical advisor for Kafka, messaging, storage-adjacent and DBRE-related platform decisions across Deliveroo, DoorDash and Wolt.
  • Design durable, extensible systems and platform capabilities that can be leveraged by other engineers and teams, reducing duplicated effort and operational risk.
  • Lead the resolution of complex distributed systems problems, including reliability incidents, performance bottlenecks, capacity constraints, data-safety risks and production-operability gaps.
  • Raise the operational excellence bar for Tier-0 infrastructure through observability, automation, incident response, runbooks, operational readiness and continuous improvement.
  • Proactively build alignment with partner teams, including EventBus, Storage, DBRE, SRE, Data Platform and Core Infrastructure, shaping joint goals and mitigating cross-org delivery risks.
  • Mentor and grow engineers through technical guidance, design, feedback, code review, incident review facilitation and knowledge-sharing across the engineering community.
  • Evaluate emerging streaming, storage and automation technologies, including AI-enabled operational tooling where appropriate, and champion pragmatic adoption where they can materially improve quality, velocity or efficiency.

What You'll Need to Thrive

Our ideal candidate will bring deep expertise in several of these areas and the judgment to lead others through ambiguity:

  • Significant experience building, operating and evolving distributed systems in production, ideally for platform or infrastructure teams supporting critical workloads.
  • Deep hands-on experience with Kafka or comparable event streaming systems as a platform, infrastructure service or business-critical production dependency.
  • Strong technical leadership skills, with a track record of defining technical direction, shaping roadmaps and leading multi-engineer or cross-team initiatives.
  • Ability to make and own technical decisions in ambiguous situations, using data, operational signals, customer needs and long-term system health to guide tradeoffs.
  • Strong coding ability in Java, Go, Python or similar languages, with a focus on reliable, maintainable, observable and scalable production systems.
  • Experience improving production reliability through automation, observability, capacity management, incident response, operational readiness and sustainable on-call practices.
  • Strong distributed systems fundamentals, including Linux, networking, storage, JVM-based systems, fault tolerance, backpressure, capacity planning and performance tuning.
  • A force-multiplier mindset: you create leverage through reusable technical foundations, clear documentation, strong engineering practices, mentoring and removing single points of failure.
  • Strong communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to influence platform, infrastructure, product and reliability teams without relying on authority.

Nice to have

  • Experience contributing to Kafka or related open source distributed systems.
  • Experience with Redpanda, WarpStream, AutoMQ, Pulsar or similar streaming technologies.
  • Experience with JVM tuning, diskless streaming architectures or multi-region event streaming platforms.
  • Experience operating Tier-0 infrastructure at large scale, including incident leadership and post-incident improvement programs.
  • Experience with database reliability, storage systems, data platforms or DBRE practices in addition to event streaming.
  • Experience using automation or AI-assisted operational tooling to improve reliability, developer experience or incident response quality.

Why Join Us?

At Deliveroo (Doordash), you'll do work that matters, solving real-world problems in a three-sided marketplace that's constantly evolving.

We're food lovers, problem solvers, community builders and more, brought together by a shared drive to make things better.

Working here you can expect to:

  • 🔧 Solve meaningful problems at real scale. Work on complex, always-on infrastructure that impacts millions every day.
  • 🌱 See your impact, fast. Shape the direction of foundational platforms used by teams across Deliveroo, DoorDash and Wolt.

description:
The opportunity

We're a stealth startup in AI and bio, building infrastructure for data generation. The team is

small and elite, the problems are hard, and the foundations are being laid right now. You'd

Youʼll help make sure laboratory teams have the consumables they need, when they need

them. Youʼll have a say in the software they use to manage stock, and learn to use AI to make

everyday purchasing and inventory work easier.

About us

AI for biology has a data problem. The data that matters most doesn't exist yet, so we're

building the infrastructure to produce it, with quality and traceability built in from day one.

We're in stealth and heads-down on execution. We'll share more about what we're building

once you've spoken with the team.

The role

This is a hands-on, early-career role within our Infrastructure team. Youʼll manage day-to-day

consumables purchasing, receive deliveries and keep stock records accurate, with training

and guidance from your manager and laboratory colleagues. As you learn the work, youʼll

organise your day independently and follow issues through to resolution.

Youʼll work with laboratory teams to understand demand, place orders within agreed budgets

and approvals, and chase delays before they disrupt work. Youʼll maintain supplier prices and

lead times, flag supply risks and get laboratory approval for any proposed substitutions.

At goods receipt, youʼll check orders against deliveries, including quantities, condition and

relevant batch, expiry and temperature requirements. Youʼll record receipts promptly, route

goods to the right storage and resolve discrepancies. Youʼll help physically set up storage

areas, organise stock into defined bin locations and label and barcode those locations so they

match the inventory records. Youʼll record stock movements and investigate differences

found during stock counts.

With guidance, youʼll propose reorder points and buffer stock using consumption, lead times

and planned activity. Youʼll track expiry dates, prioritise the earliest-expiring stock where

appropriate and maintain consistent item codes, units and pack conversions. Youʼll document

procedures, follow safety and quality requirements, and segregate items awaiting review.

Regular updates on supply risks and stock accuracy, together with reliable receipt records,

will help colleagues in the lab and finance.

Youʼll work directly with software engineers to shape the inventory tools you use every day.

Youʼll bring ideas from the lab, explain what needs to work differently and test new features

against real tasks. Your input will help decide what gets improved, with your manager and the

software team leading priorities, design and development. Youʼll also learn to use AI-assisted

workflows for tasks such as reviewing inventory data and preparing routine updates, then

help refine those workflows as you find better ways to work. Training and support will be part

of the role.

Your first 90 days

FIRST 30 DAYS

◆ Learn the consumables, storage requirements and approval processes with laboratory

colleagues. Take on routine ordering and goods receipt with support.

◆ Check stock records against physical inventory and map the journey from purchase

request to use. Agree a practical storage layout and bin-location scheme with laboratory

colleagues, taking account of access and storage requirements.

DAYS 30 TO 60

◆ Run routine ordering, receipts and stock counts independently within agreed processes.

Keep colleagues informed of shortages, overdue orders and expiring stock.

◆ Physically set up and organise the agreed storage areas, label and barcode bin

locations, and link them to inventory records. Propose replenishment settings with your

manager and laboratory colleagues, and document how stock is stored and moved. Turn

recurring problems into examples for the software team.

DAYS 60 TO 90

◆ Check that colleagues can find, receive and return stock using the labelled and

barcoded locations. Resolve gaps in the layout or records, and refine replenishment to

reduce avoidable shortages and waste.

◆ Test available inventory features against everyday tasks and help colleagues adopt

improvements. With support, try an AI-assisted workflow for a routine task, check its

outputs and suggest how to improve it.

Who you are

Youʼre proactive, organised and attentive to detail, and you enjoy practical work where

accurate records have visible consequences. When a problem arises, you flag it promptly and

investigate practical solutions while keeping colleagues informed. You act within agreed

processes, bring options when a decision needs support and follow the issue through to

resolution.

Your experience may come from inventory, purchasing, logistics or laboratory operations,

including an apprenticeship or placement. A scientific degree and coding experience are not

required. We welcome transferable experience with physical stock and time-sensitive

supplies.

Youʼre willing to help beyond a fixed task list as the team grows, while using judgement about

when to escalate. Nobody arrives with every part of this role. If you are strong in most of it

and quick to learn the rest, we want to hear from you.

MUST HAVE

◆ Practical experience of inventory, purchasing, goods receipt, logistics or laboratory

operations.

◆ Careful record-keeping and an organised approach to checking deliveries, prioritising

work and following actions through.

◆ Confidence with digital tools and a willingness to learn to use AI, check its outputs and

improve recurring workflows over time. Prior AI expertise is not required.

◆ Clear communication with suppliers and colleagues, including explaining an operational

problem to a software developer.

NICE TO HAVE

◆ Experience with laboratory consumables or expiry-sensitive and temperature-controlled

stock.

◆ Familiarity with inventory or ERP systems, barcode-based stock control, or testing new

software.

Why this is unusual

Alongside keeping supplies moving, youʼll help shape the software and AI-assisted workflows

that make the job easier. Youʼll work with engineers to turn a stock discrepancy or awkward

receiving step into a better tool, then see whether it works in practice. Youʼll build experience

in improving systems as well as running the day-to-day operation.

Youʼll have support as you learn, and room to contribute ideas from the start. Some people

find that mix energising; others prefer a more settled routine. It is worth knowing which suits

you.

How we work

This role is primarily on-site in Kingʼs Cross, London, typically four to five days a week,

because deliveries and physical inventory need someone there. The wider team is

distributed, so we write things down and keep colleagues informed.

We start the week with an all-hands and share written updates. We give feedback directly

and expect good ideas to be challenged on their merits, whoever proposes them.

UK benefits include 30 days of annual leave plus public holidays, a pension with a 10%

employer contribution after a three-month deferment, and Bupa private health cover.

The team you will join

Youʼll join the Infrastructure team and work closely with laboratory colleagues, software

engineers and finance. Your manager will help set priorities and support decisions on

inventory planning and wider process changes. Youʼll bring the day-to-day operational view

into those discussions.

Our process

We start with a short screening conversation, followed by a behavioural interview. Weʼll ask

for examples of how youʼve spotted a problem, kept others informed and taken practical

steps to solve it, including when you sought support. Next comes a role-specific work sample

and a discussion of how you approached it, followed by references. Weʼll explain the

assessment format in advance, and youʼll meet us in person before any offer.

If the role interests you, apply through the person who introduced you or the recruiter who

shared it. If youʼre unsure whether you meet every requirement, we still want to hear from

you.

We are an equal opportunity employer. We make hiring decisions on merit, scope-fit, and the

strength of the working relationship we expect to build with each hire. Applications welcome

from candidates of any background.

Comprenant 300 collaborateurs et des filiales dans de nombreux pays (France, Belgique, Suisse, Italie, République Tchèque, Emirats Arabes Unis, Brésil…), le groupe s’appuie sur sa capacité à fédérer l’excellence, via l’intégration d’expertises publicitaires leader de leur marché, de manière à concevoir et piloter des stratégies de communication 360 à l'échelle l’internationale.

Vous supervisez la production des états financiers dans le respect des normes comptables en vigueur et assurez la qualité et la fiabilité des informations financières à destination des parties prenantes internes et externes.

provisions

• Etablir les états financiers et les annexes aux comptes annuels
• Assurer l’audit des comptes en étant le point de contact principal.

• Encadrer et animer une équipe comptable (recrutement, formation, montée en compétences des collaborateurs)

• Participer à la mise en place et/ou à l’amélioration des outils comptables et des processus internes
• Accompagner les projets de transformation liés à la digitalisation des fonctions financières

• Issu(e) d’une formation supérieure en comptabilité, gestion ou finance (DSCG, Master CCA, École de Commerce ou équivalent)

Pioneer of online flash sales since 2001 and key player in European e-commerce, Veepee collaborates with over 7,000 brands to offer highly discounted products available for a limited time. Operating across various sectors, including fashion, home, wine, travel or beauty... Veepee achieved a turnover of 3.3 billion euros incl. VAT in 2024 and employs 5,000 staff members across 10 countries.

Organization and team
 

The cybersecurity team includes Red/Purple/Blue teamers and risk & compliance oriented profiles, all working together to fix security weaknesses with innovative solutions, adapted to business needs. A Bug Bounty program, an authenticated program on our partner-facing platforms, an annual external Red Team engagement and recurring compliance assessments keep us honest, and our radar sharp.

Our threat detection & incident response runs fully in-house, nothing is outsourced: you can touch everything, from detection engineering, case management and response, threat intelligence and the vulnerability lifecycle to the AI agents orchestrated on top of it all. Automation and AI are at the core of everything (who doesn't?): agents triage our alerts 24/7 so humans focus on what matters, an LLM pipeline audits our code, and every confirmed finding feeds a remediation loop with product teams.


Responsibilities

  • Attack Veepee's perimeter the way a real adversary would: red team, penetration tests (grey/black/white/AI box), Active Directory attack paths, phishing campaigns and the business web based processes themselves (member journeys, seller flows, payment chains), hunting for logic flaws no scanner will ever find.

  • Put our risk register and threat intelligence to the test: take a stated risk or an emerging threat and confirm it, or refute it, with a working attack scenario.

  • Qualify what comes in from the outside: Bug Bounty reports (public and authenticated programs) and alerts escalated by our RAG agents during the cyber-watching rotation.

  • Convert every confirmed attack path into something that runs without you: a detection rule, a hunting query, an automated control. If a bot can do it, we automate it.

  • Build and improve the team's tooling: AI-assisted code audit, password auditing, secret hunting, attack-surface monitoring.

  • Carry your findings through to remediation: explain the impact to product and infra teams, propose the fix, track it through our vulnerability-management lifecycle, and re-attack to prove it's closed.

  • Share your discoveries with technical and business teams and spread security culture in accordance with day-to-day constraints.


    • Required skills

  • The most important thing is motivation! Naturally curious profiles who enjoy proving or disproving that an attack works, and who don't consider the job done until it's fixed.

  • Solid offensive skills: web and API penetration testing (OWASP), Active Directory attack techniques, and a taste for business-logic abuse beyond the technical stack.

  • Investigation fundamentals: comfortable digging through EDR, logs and network data to reach a verdict, and turning attacker behavior into detection logic or solid on the offensive side with a strong will to grow there.

  • Scripting and automation (Python, Bash, PowerShell); interest in AI-assisted security tooling (LLM-based code audit, agentic workflows) is a strong plus.

  • You document what you do and make it reproducible.

  • Strong communication skills: you can convince a product team to fix something they didn't want to hear about.

  • Experience: ~3–5 years in offensive security, detection engineering or a mixed red/blue role.

  • Language: French and professional English.

description:

Cette bonne qualification du produit est indispensable pour obtenir une valorisation juste du produit et choisir le canal d’écoulement approprié.

● Il/elle sera le point de contact privilégié en charge des stocks Clearance pour les entrepôts et l’équipe Clearance au siège. 

● Il/elle devra être capable de demander les ressources nécessaires (humaines et/ou matérielles) pour attendre les objectifs fixés.

La performance du Responsable Qualité Stock sera évaluée par des objectifs SMART définies par semestre.

You'll go beyond writing "how-to" articles; you will design and organize a logic-driven knowledge base that serves two audiences, our customers and AI agents (including the Documentation Agent in the Pigment platform), and you'll own the quality of content for both.

Working at the intersection of Product and Customer Experience, you'll partner with subject matter experts to translate high-level product updates, including Pigment's native AI capabilities that allow users to build models simply by speaking their intent, into clear, concise, and discoverable content that drives self-service and empowers our users to master the platform independently.

  • Ensure data security and compliance by applying best practices and industry standards for handling sensitive information

title: TUM Project Study: Earned LinkedIn Media for Enterprise
description:
About us

Mediacharge GmbH is a Munich-based, internationally oriented marketing agency with ten years of experience in cutting-edge marketing for international enterprises. Operating in 14 languages, we combine first-tier strategic consulting with hands-on operational excellence, measured against business results.

Project description (TUM Project)

This project study explores what turns an enterprise’s own people into LinkedIn voices that measurably drive Sales, Recruiting or Employer Brand. Using Mediacharge and its enterprise clients as the case environment, it examines how earned media, meaning content published by real people rather than paid brand channels, creates business impact.

The project combines a business strategy perspective - objectives, the right people and measurable outcomes - with a content and platform perspective, focusing on talent profiles, content types, success patterns and the time it takes to build an effective voice.

Objectives of the project study

  • to classify enterprise objectives for earned LinkedIn media (Sales, Recruiting, Employer Brand),

  • to identify which talent profiles and content types work best for each objective,

  • to derive success patterns, including what it takes and how long it takes to see results,

  • to develop one strategy blueprint per objective and an impact model to measure business effect.

Main task and methodology

Students explore the topic through research, interviews and real enterprise cases (month 1), classify goals, talent profiles and success patterns (month 2), and build strategy blueprints, a final report and a pitch to Mediacharge leadership (month 3). Recommended methods include desk research, expert interviews, enterprise case analysis, benchmarking and impact modelling.

Student requirements

Students are fascinated by marketing at international enterprise scale, work analytically and build things that hold up in practice. Strong results open the door to a next conversation with Mediacharge.

Project scope and application

Preferred scope: 3 months in three phases: Explore, Analyse, Build

Number of students: 3–5

Invest in Values. Produce in Freedom. Boost Europe.

RIZM helps Europe's largest industrial companies – together around 2% of Europe's total energy demand – make their energy decisions with AI. Our agent RIZMO works as a digital colleague. But the most important colleagues are the ones we haven't found yet.

That's your job. We're about 15 people today and growing fast. There is no recruiting playbook yet, no big HR department and no "that's how we've always done it". You'll write the playbook. Not as application admin, but as the person who shapes who RIZM becomes.

02 · Hi, we're Diana and Josh – we'll be working together

I'm Diana, 20, I study civil engineering in Münster and I currently run recruiting at RIZM on my own, 20 hours a week. That's not enough for what's ahead of us, which is why we're looking for you. We'll build this together, side by side in our Münster office. Josh, our co-founder & CBO, comes from statistics and risk management and will be your sparring partner whenever you need one – for tricky candidates, for offers and for figuring out who we need next. Got questions before you apply? Just message me on LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/in/diana-pashaian-1637133b2/

03 · What you'll do

  • Build the team of tomorrow: Design our recruiting from scratch – roles, workflows, tools – and later bring more recruiters and sourcers on board yourself.

  • Find the right people: Track down engineers, energy experts and product people via LinkedIn, Juicebox, universities, communities and your own network.

  • Win people over: Lead first conversations, tell our story convincingly and make sure every candidate feels well looked after – even when it's a no.

  • Make it smart: Automate sequences, screening and reporting with AI instead of maintaining spreadsheets.

  • Steer by numbers: Always know where the funnel gets stuck – and turn the right dials.

  • Get us seen: Shape how RIZM is perceived as an employer – careers page, job ads, events, university partnerships.

04 · What you bring

  • Experience: You've worked in recruiting or talent acquisition, ideally in startups or tech, and you know how to approach technical profiles.

  • People sense: You spot potential even when it's not on the CV, and you talk to engineers as equals.

  • Tech affinity: You try out new tools, build your own workflows and enjoy making things faster.

  • Builder drive: You don't want to step into ready-made structures – you want to create them, independently, reliably and fast.

  • Background: A degree in psychology, business, HR, social sciences or similar – or a path that prepared you just as well.

  • Languages: Fluent German and English, written and spoken.

05 · What you get

  • Performance counts: Uncapped variable pay plus equity – good work is visible here and rewarded directly.

  • Real ownership: You're the first recruiter. What you build stays.

  • A network that moves you forward: Sparring, mentoring and learning with the networks of our investors Point 9 and Earlybird.

  • Once a year, we get out: A team workation with everyone, including conversations with inspiring guests like Robert Habeck, Kitty Mayo or James Vincent.

  • Stay fit: Urban Sports Club membership.

  • Münster office: You sit right next to our engineering team – the people you'll hire most – and you hear first-hand what makes a great engineer at RIZM. Recruiting thrives on short distances – the best ideas come up at the same table.

title: TYPO3 Developer
description:
TYPO3 Developer
(Mensch)

Andere zählen Schafe. Du zählst TYPO3-Major-Versionen, die du schon migriert hast. Und hast Lust, die Websites großer, internationaler Unternehmen technisch zu verantworten?

Zur Übersicht

Der ultimative TYPO3-Check

Du bist bei uns richtig, wenn du…

  • … bei „Wir brauchen nur ein kleines Feld mehr im Backend“ im Kopf schon TCA, Datenbank-Migration und die drei Fluid-Templates aufklappst, die es wirklich braucht.

  • … für dein wichtigstes Werkzeug hältst. Direkt nach dem Cache-Leeren.

  • … beim Satz „Das ging in TYPO3 v7 aber noch“ freundlich lächelst und den Extension Scanner startest.

  • … sofort merkst, wenn dir die KI eine TypoScript-Lösung aus dem Jahr 2014 andreht. Und sie trotzdem jeden Tag nutzt, weil sie dich schneller macht.

  • … und dein Gewissen dir verbietet, freitags um 16 Uhr ein Major-Update auf Production zu schieben. Auch nicht „nur schnell“.

… dann gilt für uns nur noch eins: composer require netfed/du

Worum geht es?

Du verantwortest die TYPO3-Technik großer Corporate-Websites. Von der Aufwandsschätzung über Konzeption und Neuaufbau bis zu Weiterentwicklung, Support und Updates. Du berätst Kolleg:innen und Kunden und sorgst dafür, dass unsere Projekte auf einem sauberen technischen Fundament stehen.

Warum diese Rolle bei uns anders ist?

Wir arbeiten für namhafte Konzerne und große Mittelständler, bei denen die Website ein strategisches Aushängeschild ist. Du baust hier nicht Website Nummer 47 nach Schema F. Du triffst die technischen Entscheidungen und verantwortest die Architektur. Dabei vertrauen wir voll auf deine Erfahrung. Dazu kommen eine eigene, von uns betriebene Cloud-Hosting-Umgebung und eine gelebte DevOps-Kultur, die sich am Stand der Technik orientiert.

Und was ist mit KI?

Gehört bei uns zum Alltag. Nicht als Pilotprojekt, sondern als Werkzeug. Du arbeitest mit KI als Sparringspartner: beim Refactoring, beim Testen, beim Dokumentieren, beim schnellen Zweitblick auf eine Migration. Die KI schlägt vor, du entscheidest. Genau deshalb suchen wir jemanden mit echter TYPO3-Erfahrung, der erkennt, wann ein Vorschlag gut ist und wann er Unsinn ist.

Was sind deine Aufgaben?

  • Du erstellst die technische Konzeption neu aufzubauender TYPO3-Websites.

Was bringst du mit?

  • 4 bis 8 Jahre Erfahrung mit der Umsetzung anspruchsvoller Websites auf Basis von TYPO3.

  • Du kennst dich mit den umgebenden Tools und Technologien aus, zum Beispiel Composer, JSON, JavaScript und XML.

  • Du arbeitest mit KI-Coding-Tools und weißt, wo sie helfen und wo nicht.

  • Du arbeitest gern agil mit Jira, Confluence und GitLab.

Wäre gut,
aber kein Muss

  • Werkzeuge: Jira, Confluence, GitLab, Office 365, Docker, Kubernetes
